articleTitle: Video road vehicle detection and tracking based on OpenCV
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: Video surveillance is widely used in security surveillance, military navigation, intelligent transportation, etc. Its main research fields are pattern recognition, computer vision and artificial intelligence. This article uses OpenCV to detect and track vehicles, and monitors by establishing an adaptive model on a stationary background. Compared with traditional vehicle detection, it not only has the advantages of low price, convenient installation and maintenance, and wide monitoring range, but also can be used on the road. The intelligent analysis and processing of the scene image using camshift tracking algorithm can collect all kinds of traffic flow parameters (including the number of vehicles in a period of time) and the specific position of vehicles at the same time, so as to solve the vehicle offset. It is reliable in operation and has high practical value.

articleTitle: Research on network security of VPN technology
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: with the wide adoption of Internet, it has become a tool that we can use to work and learn at any time anywhere as we wish. Internet has made it possible to have video conferences, take online courses and shop online. Despite the convenience it provides, Internet is an open platform on which personal data can be easily accessed and stolen. Thus, it is important to protect the network security. Network security technologies involve many aspects, and this study explores how to ensure Internet security from the use of VPN. The main function of VPN (virtual private network) is to set up a private network on the public network and encrypt the communication. The essence of VPN is to build a network tunnel in the public network using relevant encryption technology, which can conduct the data transmission safely and prevent others from sniffing. IPSec VPN, as can be seen from the literal, is a VPN that realizes remote access through the IPSec protocol. It provides a tunnel over a public network for two private networks to transmit data. This tunnel is encrypted to ensure security. The advantage of IPSec.VPN is that it is a net-to-network networking method, which can establish multilevel networking. Fixed networking mode, suitable for inter-institutional networking; Users can have transparent access and do not need to log in.

articleTitle: Educational management in Critical Thinking Training Based on Bloom’s Taxonomy and SOLO Taxonomy
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: Teaching and learning are important in tertiary education. The article focuses on the cultivation of students' critical thinking, the introduction of Bloom's Taxonomy and SOLO Taxonomy, and how to use Bloom's Taxonomy and SOLO Taxonomy. Through questioning, classroom implementation, writing, and risk management, the teacher could classify the learning content according to the difficulty of knowledge using Bloom's Taxonomy. It discusses how to make students-centered and how to training their critical thinking in the training process, how to move the obstacles existing in the process of cultivating students' critical thinking for the purpose of accomplish it.

articleTitle: Crime Analysis of spatial-temporal distribution based on KNN Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: With the rapid advance of global urbanization, the problem of urban crime is becoming more and more serious, which brings a great challenge to the police all over the world. How to use big data to drive police work has become the hot and difficult point of crime research. In this paper, the research object is theft, battery, narcotics and criminal damage in Chicago. The research method is to use visualization technology and machine learning algorithm to predict the spatial distribution of crime. Firstly, the spatial distribution characteristics of crime occurrence are analyzed by the methods of neighborhood repetition and spatial analysis. Then, the spatial distribution map of aggregated data and the crime distribution heat map are visualized. Finally, we combine the theory of crime distribution to further analyze the spatial-temporal distribution features of several crimes and criminal symbiosis.

articleTitle: Shadowsocks Traffic Identification Based on Convolutional Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: Network traffic has been massively produced since the development of the Internet. While the encryption of traffic has ensured the security and reliability of information, it also brings great challenge to the traffic identification and monitoring. The present study proposes a method of shadowsocks traffic identification based on the one-dimensional Convolutional Neural Network. This method simplifies the feature extraction of traffic identification and the recognition accuracy is over 98%. Because we can not find the published shadowsocks traffic dataset, we gathered four encryption kinds of shadowsocks traffic to study on the influence of different encryption on shadowsocks traffic. Moreover, we include VPN traffic and do contrast experiment based on four deep-learning models to verify the efficiency of one-dimensional convolutional neural network.

articleTitle: Big Data Mining and Analysis of Hot Issues in International Education—Based on K-means algorithm of cluster analysis
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: in the era of big data, international education has accumulated a lot of relevant data, which can produce various research values. The Corona Virus Disease 2019 (COVID-19) seriously affects the development of international education. This paper starts with the hot spots of international education and international higher education. Moreover, based on xinhuanet.com database and CSSCI database, and through K-means algorithm in data mining clustering analysis algorithms, the Cite Space visual software is used to make keywords analysis, emotional color analysis, and centrality analysis, thus getting the hot issues in international education and the frontier focus. Furthermore, combined with COVID-19 spread globally, these problems are analyzed, the future direction and development of international education are discussed, and reasonable and scientific suggestions and thinking are proposed.

articleTitle: Research on the application of new generation of Human-computer interaction in education
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: Natural user interface is a new generation of human-computer interaction. It takes nature as the core and has speech recognition, gesture recognition, touch screen, touch, eye movement tracking and brain-computer interface. Natural user interfaces are suitable for education because they reduce cognitive load, improve learning immersion, and facilitate access to learning feedback. Based on the natural user interface, this paper explores the psychological theory foundation and application mode of human-computer interaction in teaching.

articleTitle: Research on teaching reform of electrical and electronic training innovative talents training based on computer technology
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: The idea of network education based on computer technology is a supplement to the cultivation of innovative talents. There is no central point in the structure of network technology based on computer technology. Its structure determines that its inner spirit is decentralized and equal. Its structure determines that the inner spirit is decentralized and equal. In order to adapt to and innovate the arrival of the Internet era, the teaching understanding and thinking are changed, and the teaching structure is changed, and the improvement of teaching methods is promoted. On this basis, this paper expounds and summarizes the practical training process of electrical and Electronic Training and innovation and entrepreneurship teaching for college students.

articleTitle: Quatemary Hermitian linear complementary dual codes with small distance
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: Massey introduced a class of linear code which is called linear complementary dual (LCD) codes. It has been known that LCD codes play a significant role in improving the security of the information processed by sensitive device. In this paper, we constructed 166 quaternary Hermitian linear complementary dual codes with small distance, where 154 codes are new constructions. Besides, it includes 145 Hermitian optimal LCD codes and 9 Hermitian near optimal LCD codes.

articleTitle: Online Flipped Classroom Based on Task-Driven Teaching Practice : Take Introduction to Systems Engineering as an example
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: Flipped classroom is an effective teaching method to improve teaching efficiency and quality. However, flipped classroom can easily lead to the defects of fragmentation of teaching process and polarization of learning effect, which hinders its effective application in online teaching. Task-driven teaching has the advantages of clear tasks and systematic knowledge, which can make up for the shortcomings of online teaching in flipped classroom. Aiming at the characteristics of online teaching under COVID-19 epidemic, this research carried out the design of task-driven online flipped classroom teaching model and explored practice. Based on the comprehensive use of multi-dimensional information platform, the situational design aroused and motivated the interest of students. The continuously upgrading tasks lead students to realize the conversion of knowledge mastery to ability formation. The effectiveness of online learning is comprehensively evaluated to realize the healthy operation of the teaching process and finally achieve the teaching goals.

articleTitle: Research on Evolution and Control of Network Public Opinion Based on SEIR Model with Martial Law Mechanism
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: The spread of public opinions on the Internet for emergencies can easily cause public crisis, which requires the active governance of government departments. Based on the SEIR infectious disease dynamics model, the prediction and evaluation of the evolution and prevention of public opinion in public emergencies were conducted, and the evolution process model of public opinion considering the isolation mechanism was established. The results show that the SEIR infectious disease dynamics model is reliable in the analysis of online public opinion communication situation, and can provide certain theoretical support for the evolution and prevention of online public opinion.

articleTitle: Study on the Methods of Curriculum Ideology and Politics Integration into the Course of “Basics of Mechanical Design” Based on the Data Analysis by SPSS
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: According to the demand of education sectors and combined with the features of the course of basics of mechanical design, this paper discusses the integration of the core values of Chinese socialism and craftsman spirit into the regular teaching, and put forward some integration methods which include differing from the knowledge, differing from the students, guiding from event or teaching emergency, and differing from the teaching place based on the online survey and the data analysis of SPSS. And it also gives some explanation about these methods.

articleTitle: Application and Innovation of Artificial Intelligence Technology in College Sports
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: The rapid growth of emerging technologies with artificial intelligence and big data as new representatives has brought great influence to all walks of life, as well as the education. College sports is an important part of the education system and deeply affected by the artificial intelligence. The paper will briefly summarize the current status of college physical education in China and discuss how to innovate its methods in the era of artificial intelligence.

articleTitle: Research on English Teaching Mode in College Based on Artificial Intelligence
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: College English under the traditional mode, whether in teaching content, teaching methods, teaching evaluation, etc., has been unable to adapt to the actual learning needs of current students, and the practical application of artificial intelligence in the field of education can really solve the limitation of teaching time and space. In this context, teachers need to truly realize the role of artificial intelligence in college English teaching and deeply study the new college English teaching mode under the background of artificial intelligence, so as to ensure that college English teaching objectives can be more effectively completed.

articleTitle: Infrared Target Tracking Algorithm Based on Bernoulli Filter and Support Vector Machine
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: Infrared small target tracking algorithm is an important method to obtain the target states effectively. Support Vector Machine (SVM), a classic method in machine learning methods, is effective for target recognition. The Bernoulli filter is the optimal single-target filter for target tracking within the Bayesian framework. However, there is no related research on the joint application of the SVM and Bernoulli filter for infrared small target tracking. In this paper, the SVM and Bernoulli filter are jointly applied to the tracking and recognition of small targets in complex backgrounds. The research shows that, with the SVM, Bernoulli filter can indeed be applied to the actual multi-frame infrared target tracking scene to achieve effective tracking and recognition of infrared small targets.

articleTitle: The Evaluation of the Objectives Achievement Degree for “Principles and Application of Single-chip Microcomputer” Course Based on OBE Model
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: The evaluation for achievement degree of course objectives is an important link in the whole process of undergraduate talent training, an important basis for measuring whether students meet the graduation requirements for their major, and also a key link for continuous improvement. Taking the “principles and applications of single-chip microcomputer” course as an example, this paper puts forward an evaluation method of course objectives achievement based on OBE model. Firstly, according to the characteristics of the course, the objectives of knowledge and engineering abilities involved in the course are clarified, as well as the supporting relationship of the index points for graduation requirements. Secondly, the assessment links, methods, contents and criterions are determined for each course objective, as well as their supporting relationship with each course objective. Thirdly, through the portfolio evaluation method, the achievement degree of course objectives are determined. Finally, the continuous improvement measures are proposed. The practice results show that this method can effectively find the shortcomings in the teaching process and improve the students' abilities to solve complex engineering problems.

articleTitle: Analysis on the Influencing Factors of Graduate Employment Quality Based on Training Data Mining
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: This paper takes an electronic information university with obvious industry characteristics as an example, and conducts data mining research on the school's 2016-2018 electronic information graduate training data. This paper on the basis of literature reading and sorting, select whether to enter the world's top 500 and whether to work in an economically developed area as the graduate employment quality evaluation indicators, and use 12 indicators that may affect the quality of graduate employment for cross-statistical analysis. Finally, 8 variables including the number of articles published, weighted grades of degree courses, academic scholarships, and book readings are comprehensively determined for further data mining. The research results show that, in addition to the objective factor of gender, the weighted grades of degree courses and academic scholarships have a significant positive impact on the high-quality employment of graduate students during the training process.

articleTitle: The application design of hearing aid parameters auto adaptive system for hearing impaired children based on android terminal
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: In order to realize a mode of hearing aid parameters adjustment which is efficient, electronic and convenient for hearing impaired children, an auto adaptive solution of hearing aid parameters based on deep neural network sound environment classification on Android terminal is proposed. In this scheme, a deep neural network based sound environment classification method is adopted on Android terminal, and multi-frames accumulation and multi-blocks statistics are used to improve the classification accuracy, and then the corresponding hearing aid parameters are matched for different sound environment categories and sent to the hearing aid to realize the auto adaptive of hearing aid to dynamic sound environment.

articleTitle: Research on the Application of Blockchain in Credit Bank
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: This paper aims to explore and solve the difficult problems faced in the development of traditional credit banks, and analyze the adaptability of blockchain technology in credit banks. The credit chain was designed with Beihang Chain as a prototype, and the transaction speed, scalability and credibility were improved through technologies such as domain indexing, dual-chain concurrency and parallel Byzantine protocol. Then the credit chain is applied to the credit bank architecture to provide an effective solution for the construction of credit bank.

articleTitle: Statistical Analysis based on SPSS and Empirical Research on Curriculum Ideology and Politics Implementation in Professional Basic Courses: Digital Communication Course as an Example
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: Curriculum ideology and politics refers to a concept of comprehensive education which contains the ideological and political education contents in various professional courses and general education courses. It can construct a pattern of all-members-participation, entire-process and all-courses education, and regard the moral education as the fundamental task of education. As an important part of talent training, professional basic courses also carry the important historical mission of ideological and political education. With the help of SPSS (Statistical Product and Service Solutions) software, statistical analysis of the current situation of curriculum ideology and politics implementation is fist done based on CNKI database. Then, this paper points out the main problems faced in professional basic courses with some typical cases analysis. To take the Digital Communication course as an empirical example, we put forward some strategies and the suggestions to carry out curriculum ideology and politics in professional basic courses. Specifically, it consists of five aspects, including improving the teachers' ideological consciousness and literacy, formulating the implementation plan and teaching content, mining the education elements of ideology and politics, exploring the coherence point of ideological elements and subject knowledge, and innovating the teaching methods. Using case analysis method, empirical results based on concept map show that the statistical analysis approach used in this paper is effective and universal.

articleTitle: Informal learning research based on mobile portable devices
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: Formal learning and informal learning have always been two ways of learning, but little research has been done on informal learning. It wasn't until the establishment of MOOC in 2012 that this kind of off-campus learning gained traction. This paper first discusses the definition of informal learning and its advantages, then introduces two mobile device-based informal learning methods, and makes an outlook on their prospects and problems.

articleTitle: Instructional Design and Application of Hydraulic Turbine Based on MR (Mixed Reality) HoloLens 2
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: Introducing HoloLens 2 based MR (mixed reality) technology into hydraulic turbine course can solve the problems that students cannot see the internal structure of hydraulic turbine and cannot disassemble the parts of the hydraulic turbine and can improve the instructional result of the course. MR will transform traditional instructional method of hydraulic turbine. MR instructional designs of hydraulic turbine were discussed in detail, such as some questions for MR instructional design, instructional design model and MR instructional design of hydraulic turbine. The development of hydraulic turbine MR course was also presented and four modules of bulb tubular turbine, such as structure module, principle module, equipment awareness module and assemble test module, were introduced in detail.

articleTitle: Research on Influencing Factors of Continuous Learning Willingness for Online Courses From the Perspective of Interaction
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: To explore and analyze the influencing factors towards continuous learning willingness for online courses, a model was built from an interactive perspective with learning experience as the mediator variable. Through questionnaire survey, an empirical research was conducted, which showed that the interactive content, interactive platform and interactive behavior had significant impact on continuous learning willingness for online courses. For interactive content, quality characteristics has a greater impact than systematic design. For interactive platform, technical support has a greater impact than interface design. For interactive behavior, the level of learner-teacher interaction has a greater impact than that of learner-learner interaction and learner-platform interaction. Learning experience plays a mediating role. Finally, several countermeasures and suggestions are provided for relevant subjects of online education in order to promote the healthy and sustainable development of online education in China.

articleTitle: Preliminary Study on the Teaching Design of Curriculum Ideology and Political Education in “The Basis of Computer Hardware Technology” Based on ADDIE Model
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: “The basis of computer hardware technology” is a public basic course of engineering in colleges and universities, the course content has a strong theoretical, engineering and practical nature. In the past, teaching mainly focus on the professional knowledge and skills, lacking in the cultivation of thinking, philosophy, politics and humanistic quality. In this paper, we make a preliminary exploration on the teaching design of curriculum ideological and political education in “The basis of computer hardware technology” course, and the ADDIE model is introduced to integrate the elements of ideological and political in classroom lectures, after-school assignments, course experiments and examinations, through the combination of “knowledge transfer and value guidance” by taking professional knowledge education as the carrier, to further improve students' scientific and humanistic qualities, to establish students' sound moral principles and deep national sentiments, to promote students' all-round development, and to meet the needs of talent cultivation.

Author Keywords: The basis of computer hardware technology

articleTitle: Discussion on the Reform of Electronic Information Engineering Graduation Design under the Background of IEET Engineering
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: Graduation design is the most important comprehensive practice link for training undergraduates to solve practical problems. This article introduces the core competence requirements of graduation design from the perspective of IEET engineering education certification, and combines the problems existed in the graduation design of the school's electronic information engineering major, and proposes reform methods to improve the quality of graduation design and promotes the improvement of the quality of graduation design.

articleTitle: Discussion on Experimental Teaching Method of Fixed-wing UAV Flight Control
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: In order to enable students to more intuitively understand the operation mechanism of UAVs and practice UAV flight control procedures, the fixed-wing UAV path tracking experiment teaching is introduced into the course teaching of the UAV flight control technology. This paper summarizes the content and implementation steps of the experimental teaching method of UAV flight control technology, and discusses the experimental teaching practice based on the design of fixed-wing UAV path tracking algorithm. Through the guided analysis and after-class questionnaire survey, it is explained that the implementation of the experimental course will enable students to better grasp the theoretical knowledge of the course and cultivate the practical ability.

Author Keywords: Fixed-wing UAV flight control path tracking course experiment

articleTitle: Research on school education reform under the background of "5G + education"
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: With the continuous development of science and technology, mankind has entered the 5G era. In this background, the development of many fields will face great opportunities and challenges, including the field of education. The previous teaching mode, method and content are difficult to adapt to the development needs of 5G era. Therefore, it is of great significance to study the school teaching reform in the era of "5G + education". Based on this, this paper first analyzes the challenges and opportunities brought by the 5G era to school education, and then studies the school education reform in the era of "5G + education", hoping to provide some reference and help for the reform and development of school education in the era of "5G + education".

articleTitle: Analysis of Instructional Design Based on Deep Learning Perspective
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: Deep learning is considered to be the only way for students to develop in an all-round way. It helps to cultivate the masters of the future society who have a sense of social responsibility and courage to take responsibility. It is the inevitable result of the development of educational science. However, the long-standing shallow learning makes the original vivid classroom become a “one-man show” for teachers, and teaching only completes the copying and translation of knowledge. Therefore, it is urgent to put forward scientific and practical teaching design for deep learning. Based on the analysis of the characteristics of deep learning, this paper compares it with shallow learning, and puts forward the guiding principles of teaching design from four aspects: teaching objectives, teaching contents, teaching strategies and teaching evaluation, in order to provide theoretical reference and methodological reference for teachers to build “deep learning classroom”.

articleTitle: Intelligent Training Scheme for Online Judge System Designed Based on Problem Classification Using Similarity of Abastract Syntax Tree of Source Codes
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: In this paper, an intelligent training model is designed for the OJ (Online Judge) system. In the traditional OJ system, students practice on a problem-by-problem basis, and get a score for completing a problem. In the intelligent training mode, all the problems are divided into categories according to knowledge points, and students practice on a category-by-category basis, and get a score for completing a category. Each student has to complete a different number of problems in the same category (the system will intelligently determine whether the student has met the passing conditions), thus achieving the goal of personalized training in a hierarchical manner. In order to reduce the teachers' workload and improve the classification accuracy, the similarity matrix is constructed based on the similarity of the abstract syntax tree (AST) of the problems' source code, and the problems are clustered by the K-Means algorithm, and good results are obtained.

articleTitle: Organization of Knowledge Engineering Subject Using TTD Model Based on Stepwise Refinement Framework
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: Knowledge engineering is a new subject of engineering technology. As an interdisciplinary subject of social science and natural science, it is the result of the interpenetration of science and engineering. Knowledge engineering aims to obtain large quantity of knowledge and information in high efficiency with modem technology. In that case, the technology would promote the intelligence the creativity of people in highest level. Moreover, it would make people grasp knowledge and skills to promote the ability of using information with modern tools. The emergence of knowledge engineering shows that the special culture, science, knowledge and thought of human beings are closely related to modern machines. This not only promotes the renewal of electronic computer products, but also has a profound impact on the new leap of social productivity and the new changes of social life. As a kind of engineering technology knowledge engineering, its main object is to study how to form a new communication, education and control system which is composed of electronic computer and modem communication technology. Therefore, this project is of great significance to the development of social economy, science and technology, culture and education, and to accelerate the process of social informatization. In order to meet the social needs, we have set up the course named “Knowledge Engineering”. This course is an elective course for students in the school of computer science and technology in our university. This paper introduces the organization of the knowledge engineering subject using TTD modle based on stepwise refinement framework including properties, teaching purposes, teaching content and examination and performance evaluation method. Using TTD model the organization of this subject will be more reasonable. The contents will be more completed and better effect will be achieved.

articleTitle: Design of the Introduction Part of Information Processing and Machine Translation Course for Students Majoring in Computer Science and Technology
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: Machine translation is the process that the computer transforms one natural language (source language) to another (target language). It is a branch of Computational Linguistics and one of the ultimate goals of the research in Artificial Intelligence. Machine translation is of applicable importance as well as scientific importance. Due to the rapid development of Internet and globalization of economic, machine translation plays an increasingly important role in promoting an open exchange of politics, economy and culture. Therefore, the course of information processing and machine translation has been set up as an elective course for the students of computer science in our university. Around 100 students attend this course each year. The course has demanded considerable investment of time and effort. Introduction is a very important part for a course. It can make the students understand the objectives, tasks, connotation and characteristics of the course. Moreover, the introduction part can provide the students the outline of the course and arouse the students' enthusiasm. This paper introduced the design of the introduction of this course, including subject depending, problem posing, tortuous process, problem of ambiguity, revival of natural language processing, the motive force of modem social progress, perception and cognition, valuable cognitive knowledge, the contribution of natural language processing to knowledge acquisition.

articleTitle: Multi-relay selection of hybrid satellite-terrestrial cooperative network based on CR-NOMA in AF mode
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: This paper investigates the impact of relay selection on cognitive radio non-orthogonal multiple access (CR-NOMA) based satellite-ground cooperation network. By analyzing the signal-to-interference-plus-noise ratio (SINR) at the User 1, we propose a two-stage relay selection scheme, and derive the exact outage probability expression and the progressive probability expression of the primary user. Finally, theoretical simulations are used to verify the correctness of the deduced results and the impact of related variables on system performance.

articleTitle: Research on the Development Status and Future Trend of Early-Childhood Education in China under the background of Education Informatization
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: This paper first explains the definition of Early Childhood Education Industry and shows its specific types of subdivision. In the aspect of Kindergarten Education, the author takes the supply-side policy support as the starting point, then calculates the number of single kindergarten students and the Gap of Teachers' Strength, and also finds that there has an obvious problem that teachers' structure hangs upside down between the private and public kindergartens. In addition, in the aspect of Early-Childhood Education other than Kindergarten Education, the author discusses Early Education and Parent-Child Park, Childcare Service and Preschool Training. Finally, this paper studies the education informatization, online education and AI + education in the field of early education, draws the industrial chain structure chart and the profit pattern chart and looks forward to the future development direction from the survey data, to offer suggestions for the related departments and early childhood education practitioners.

articleTitle: A comparative study of online teaching modes in Higher Vocational Colleges based on network questionnaire survey and SPSS analysis
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: The novel coronavirus pneumonia has a great impact on the normal school teaching. The higher vocational colleges fully respond to the requirement of the Ministry of education, and carry out online teaching. This paper summarizes four online teaching modes widely used in Higher Vocational Colleges during the epidemic period, namely synchronous live teaching, asynchronous MOOC teaching, online flipped classroom and online collaborative discussion mode. In this study, “Questionnaire Star” software was used for network questionnaire survey, and SPSS 23.0 was used for data processing and analysis. This paper makes a comparative study from the aspects of teaching mode, teacher-student participation, use platform, advantages and implementation difficulties, and discusses the reform of post epidemic online teaching in higher vocational colleges.

articleTitle: Research on Collaborative Learning of College English Based on the Internet Mixed Online and Offline Teaching
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: Collaborative learning is a creative and effective teaching theory and strategy system with students' cooperation as the basic power and group activities as the essential teaching methods. Collaborative learning is a kind of all-round learning in which teachers assign learning tasks and control the teaching process, and let students cooperate to carry out English practice activities within or between groups under the guidance of teachers, so as to complete the learning tasks and achieve the teaching goals. This thesis will discuss the advantages of collaborative learning and its application in the mixed teaching of college English online and offline, aiming at exploring the effective ways and methods of implementing collaborative teaching mode in blended teaching of college English online and offline. Hopefully, through this paper, a teaching mode suitable for the characteristics of students in this class can be found, further promoting the reform of college English teaching mode, guiding the reform of college English teaching in the same grade and the whole university.

articleTitle: Research and Practice of O2O Hybrid Teaching Mode Based on Multi-Internet Platform
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: There are many disadvantages and limitations in traditional undergraduate teaching mode, so we have applied the O2O hybrid teaching mode to “Digital Logic and Digital Circuit” course and carried out the online and offline hybrid teaching mode reform based on multi-internet platform such as Fan-Ya platform and Rain Classroom. Through the use of multi-platform, the effective integration of offline classroom, online classroom and mobile classroom has been promoted, and many good results have been achieved such as improving students' ability to learn independently, breaking the classroom space-time limitations, promoting teacher-student exchanges, stimulating students' interest in learning, accurate evaluation of students' learning process, then promoting the steady development of teaching to a higher-order, innovative and challenging level.

articleTitle: Research and practice of Internet Teaching – Take the course of Innovation and Entrepreneurship Education and Practice as an example
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: At the beginning of this year (2020), due to the impact of the Coronavirus disease, colleges and universities across the country, as well as primary and secondary schools, were unable to carry out classroom teaching. In response to the call of “stop classes without suspension” advocated by the Ministry of Education, most schools actively used Internet teaching platforms Online teaching. Internet teaching has become an important part of informatization teaching in major universities. “Innovation and Entrepreneurship Education and Practice” is a public compulsory course for undergraduates of the whole school. However, in online teaching, all teachers and students have encountered many problems. For example, teachers and students cannot communicate face-to-face, and students cannot really practice and demonstrate entrepreneurial projects. Therefore, this thesis mainly uses content analysis and SPSS data analysis software to study Internet teaching, and proposes reasonable practical methods that can be applied to the Internet teaching of “Innovation and Entrepreneurship Education and Practice”.

articleTitle: The Psychological Status of Vocational Female College Students Based on SPSS
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: In big data Era the psychological status of vocational female college students is changed. In this paper, taking Dalian Vocational and Technical College as the investigation object to carry out empirical research by multivariate statistical analysis. The results show that there are significant differences in the psychological status of students in different grades and majors. The female college students lack adaptability, interpersonal communication skills and the ability to correctly face various pressures such as emotion and employment. This paper studies the psychological problems of female college students in higher vocational colleges in the big data era and puts forward corresponding suggestions and measures.

articleTitle: Optimization of Teaching Content and Reform of Teaching Methods on the Course of Coal-Geology Based on Big Data Analysis
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: Coal-geology course is one of the core courses of resource exploration engineering major in most universities of geology, mining and petroleum. In the process of teaching, we should constantly improve the optimization design of course content, optimize course content and reform teaching methods through big data technology analysis. On the basis of the training goal, requirement, the study purpose and the emphasis difference of resource exploration engineering major, the course has relatively fewer class schedule, obviously, fewer theoretical and experimental classes, it increases the difficulty of teachers to master the teaching content of the course. Since the content of the course is the basis of ensuring the teaching goal, talent training and implementation process, therefore, the content of the course should be targeted and selected, we should grasp flexibly the big data features of systematicness, scientificalness and progressiveness of courses content, improving students' learning motivation and active participation, making full use of information technology, constantly innovating teaching methods, improving teaching quality, promoting teaching level and students' comprehensive quality, in this way, we can ensure the unity of teaching process, optimization design and teaching efficiency.

articleTitle: Effects of “4D Situational Multimedia Interaction” on Modern Non-commissioned Officer Education
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: The rapid development of informatized technology has essentially exerted unavoidable and powerful influence upon modern higher education. To promote the efficiency and the effect of higher education, it is high time that higher education institutions integrated both informatized hardware (such as projectors, interactive TV set, WIFI, Virtual Reality devices) and intelligent software (such as PC/mobile-phone-based APPs with artificial intelligence, and audio-visual multimedia) with teaching practice in class. This paper dwells on the 4D situational multimedia interaction (4DSMI) based on informatized hardware including projectors, WIFI, VR and software like CoolEditPro which automatically provides assessment and grades immediately after each dubbing practice. Through the informatized hardware and software aforementioned, the 4DSMI aims at arousing sense organs, producing emotional resonance, deepening cognitive identification, and ultimately promoting linguistic competency. It researches on the relevance of 4DSMI with NCOs' linguistic competency, the design and purpose of 4DSMI, its implementation in the real class and its effects. It finds out that 4DSMI plays a vital role in getting NCOs emotionally interested, physically involved, cognitively identified and practically achieved in military English class.

articleTitle: Research on University Education Reform in the Era of Artificial Intelligence
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: At present, artificial intelligence is developing faster than expected by human beings, and has been highly valued by the leaders of all countries in the world. With the breakthrough development of artificial intelligence technology in recent years, the era of artificial intelligence has come, and artificial intelligence has penetrated into all aspects of social life. At the same time, the development of university education is also deeply influenced by the development of artificial intelligence technology. On the basis of expounding the development status of artificial intelligence, this paper lists the existing application of artificial intelligence technology in university education in the world, analyzes the challenges brought by artificial intelligence technology to university education, and points out the development trend of university education and corresponding education reform suggestions from the perspective of artificial intelligence, so as to promote the innovation and development of university education.

articleTitle: Sharing Cloud Platform Applied to Teaching System Reform based on “5G+Smart Education” Innovation
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: With the support of 5G network technology and environment, the core business of education is also facing transformation and reconstruction. Due to the diversity of users in the education field and the diversity of contexts, their needs are relatively wide, and the business for each need is relatively accurate. As the 5G environment can mainly provide high-speed, high-bandwidth, low-latency, fast cache, and other services, this is also an important problem faced by traditional education services. This research will propose an innovative shared cloud platform design based on “5G + Smart Education” for the reform of the teaching system and analyze and evaluate its main functional characteristics. Finally, the development prospects and future research directions of 5G+ smart education are prospected.

articleTitle: Edge Detection of Space Station Docking Mark Based on Improved Canny Operator
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: This paper proposes an improved algorithm combining mathematical morphology and Canny for edge detection of spacecraft docking marks to address the problems occurring during spacecraft near-field docking such as low accuracy of edge detection due to salt-and-pepper noise interference and easy generation of false edges. To eliminate the influence of ambient light in space, the author first converted RGB to CIE Lab color space to separate brightness and chromaticity information. The salt-and-pepper noise caused by space ionizing radiation and cosmic rays is filtered out by a combined filter. Then, the cropped docking mark image is subjected to OTSU binarization, and the high interference from noise and docking mark scale is further eliminated by a mathematical morphological low pass filter OCCO. Finally, edge detection is performed on the processed image with Canny. Experimental results show that the algorithm can effectively remove the interference from salt-and-pepper noise and scale while retaining the edge details of the image and reducing its false edges, and thus improve the accuracy and effectiveness of detection.

articleTitle: Exploration on the First-class Courses Construction of Microcomputer Principles and Single Chip Microcomputer Interface Technology
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: Aiming at construction of First-class curriculum, the courses “Microcomputer Principle and Interface Technology” and “Single-chip Microcomputer” are combined into one course according to there are similar instruction architecture. Two main section include into this combined course, microcomputer principle and interface technology. In the part of microcomputer principle focuses on the intel 80X86 processor architecture and instruction set. In the part of interface technology focuses on intel 8051 interface circuit and C language programming. The related experimental topics are also increased to provide more practical opportunities for students. The start time of this combined course is moved up to spring semester in second year. With these reforms above made this course to provide beneficial support for innovative practice of students. After more than three years of practice, the ability for students to use microcomputers and practical innovation have been greatly improved, which is reflected in the fact that students have achieved very good results in various innovation competitions.

articleTitle: Construction of Training Mode of IT Applied Talents under the Concept of Collaborative Innovation
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: A computer course system with distinctive characteristics for application-oriented undergraduate students is constructed based on the training model of IT application-oriented innovative talents of computer major with one subject, four pillars and fifteen training indexes. The talent training mode of work-study combination is established, and the talent training platform based on collaborative innovation is built, so as to finally realize the overall goal of training computer professionals with computing thinking and innovative practice ability and meeting the needs of industries and enterprises.

articleTitle: Research on Mixed Teaching Mode Based on MOOC Platform-Taking “Financial Accounting Practice” as an Example
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: Informatization and the Internet are changing our lives, including our studies. Blended teaching that organically combines traditional offline classroom teaching and online teaching. Because of its rich teaching content, novel teaching design, and students as the main body, it greatly improves students' initiative and enthusiasm. It has shown great advantages in the higher vocational teaching and is being actively adopted by major universities. This paper studies the reform of the mixed teaching mode of the course “Financial Accounting Practice” based on the MOOC platform.

articleTitle: A Further Study on Interest Conflicts in Modern Apprenticeship Pilot Work: Python-based Analysis from Key and Supporting Level
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: Based on python analysis, as a complex system, the modern apprenticeship pilot work needs to follow the guiding principle of “conforming to the government”-industry organizations shall conform to the government departments, so as to solve the conflicts of interest between the 2 at key levels, and also follows the guiding principle of “adapting to parents”-the media and foreign researchers shall adapt to the parents, so as to solve the conflicts of the attitude and social benefits between the 3 at the supporting level, thus taking joint efforts in talents cultivation.

articleTitle: Discussion on the key technologies of Intelligent Teaching System application in the era of artificial intelligence 2.0
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: In order to explore the problems of the key technology of intelligent teaching system in the era of artificial intelligence 2.0 and promote the development of intelligent teaching system better, we study the status and role of the four key technologies in intelligent teaching system. This paper takes four modules of intelligent teaching system as the objects, and discusses four key technologies supporting the application of intelligent teaching system, namely natural language processing, question answering system, expression recognition, educational data mining, etc. This paper discusses the status and the role of key technologies in the intelligent teaching system in the era of artificial intelligence 2.0, and the problems, causes and the necessity of solving in the application and development process of intelligent teaching system. The research results of this paper can provide a theoretical basis for the application of intelligent teaching system in the era of artificial intelligence 2.0, and standardize the orderly development of intelligent teaching system.

articleTitle: A Graph Signal Processing Based Strategy for Deep Neural Network Inference
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: Deep neural networks (DNNs) have played a critical role in a variety of real-world applications, such as image processing, speech recognition and autonomous driving. For the sake of deploying DNN on embedded devices and applying in practical application scenes, parallelization is required to accelerate the inference of DNN models. However, unlike the fully connected weight matrix, the sizes of convolutional kernel and deconvolution kernel are usually too small to match the output of the previous layer, which makes convolution and deconvolution hard to parallelize. In this paper, the graph signal processing (GSP) technology is firstly introduced to adjust the convolutional and deconvolution operation for parallelization. The input of the convolutional layer is represented by graph signal, and then the convolutional kernel is transformed into the graph filter matrix by GSP technology. To further accelerate inference process, the layer fusion is adopted in this work. We have implemented our method on the Jetson embedded development board with Nvidia Unified Compute Device Architecture (CUDA). The experimental results show that the graph signal processing based DNN is valid. And it is effective in regularizing deep neural network and benefit to speed up on embedded GPU platforms.

articleTitle: A Urban Economic Vitality Model Based on Nash Equilibrium to Analyze the Impact of Enterprises and Talents with Matlab
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: How to seize the key factors and effectively improve the regional economic vitality is a subject worthy of study. In this paper, we analyze how enterprise and talents impact to city economic vitality by building a Game Theory based Urban Economic Vitality model (GTUEV model) to tackle this problem. Our simulation experiment is implemented in Matlab. Firstly, we introduce the Theil coefficient to analyze enterprise policies as well as adopt time-series global method to analyze talent policies. It can be concluded that the impact of talent policies on economic vitality has a significant lag of about 1.8 years. Then the Nash equilibrium is used to optimize the model. Based on our model, we can draw the conclusion: In the short term, economic grows most dynamically when investment for talents accounts for 38% of the total resources. In the long term, the best time for the growth of economic vitality comes when investment for talents accounts for 52% of the total resources. In case of urgent need for economic recovery after the rampant of COVID-19, it can help the government to provide constructive suggestions.

articleTitle: Research on the Application of Visual Information Communication in Web Design in the Digital Age
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: The characteristic of the digital age is the widespread application of digital technology. From the beginning of the realization of visual image presentation through digital technology, media communication gave digital technology to express tension, communication effect and market demand. Digital technology has also become an effective platform for displaying content in media, an innovative tool and a carrier of communication. Among them, web pages are a new type of information carrier, and web interfaces are used as a medium for digital design to interact with people. In the digital age of information-laden information, how to accurately and scientifically convey information has become a problem we need to pay attention to. The article first identified related concepts such as "image art", "webpage image" and "digital technology", and by comparing with traditional web design technology, it analyzes the advantages and characteristics of digital virtual media to present web images. Based on the scientific and effectiveness of web visual information transmission, from the scientific nature of user acceptance process, the effectiveness of web page component layout and natural user experience, the relevant interface design principles and methods are used to explain the scientific and effective visual information transmission on web pages specific application in design.

articleTitle: The Core Competencies of Chinese College Students Based on Big Data Analysis
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: The core competencies of Chinese college students draw attention from Chinese academic circles in recent years. At present, how to use big data to search, organize, analyze and visualize the massive literature on the core competencies of college students, and how to draw the research context and trend of the core competencies of college students are the key problems to be solved. Under the premise of defining the basic concepts, using information technology, data analysis and literature research methods to sort out the research results of core competencies in China, and analyze the track and main results of the core competencies research of college students in China through CiteSpace software and make a comprehensive evaluation. Aims at affirming academic contribution, and then forming a new academic growth point.

articleTitle: A Study of Influences of Big Data on Machine Translation and Enlightenment for Translation Teaching in Cross-cultural Communication
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: Machine translation (MT) has been fiercely discussed and studied recently, especially neural machine translation (NMT). Most of the studies concentrated on MT working mechanism, translation systems, translation methodologies and chronological studies on the development of MT. However, there has been little work exploring the connection between big data and MT, or the influences of big data on MT. As the “Internet<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">†</sup> Era” comes, big data has so many influences on researches, work, studies, daily life etc. This paper examines how and from which aspects big data will affect MT, which shows that the following perspectives will be influenced: linguistic habit, translation of newly-born words, update rules of languages, English for special purpose (ESP), discourse systems with Chinese characteristics, hardware and software of computers, translation systems and storage ability, MT teaching, etc. With the research findings, this paper also proposes enlightenments for translation teaching so as to provide more qualified personnel to meet the demand of the market in cross-cultural communication.

articleTitle: Exploration and Analysis on “Online + Offline” Blended Teaching Mode Reform
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: The “online+offline” blended teaching mode integrates the conventional offline teaching and online teaching, fully arouses students' enthusiasm for autonomous learning. The blended teaching mode is deeply studied from the perspective of the type, features and advantages of blended teaching, its relationship with conventional teaching and implementation procedures, etc. The various developed teaching resources are used to build the teaching research special platform, and the “online+offline” blended teaching mode is established on the basis of offline class teaching and class online autonomous learning and outward development so as to make students fully master theoretical knowledge and make in-depth consideration and remarkably promote learning effects. Meanwhile, this teaching mode also imposes higher requirements on the quantity and quality of online teaching resources and teachers' proficiency of information-based teaching instrument.

articleTitle: Public opinion analysis about The coronavirus COVID-19 based on micro-blog data
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: It is known to all that Coronavirus disease 2019 (COVID-19) is an infectious disease, which has spread to more than 180 countries and territories around the world since the end of 2019.lt is clear that this disease results in a moment of panic. However, some people used the data of Tieba to analyze public opinion and describe the intensity of people's emotions, but Tieba is not representative. Because whether it is in terms of popularity, number of users or age spread, the data of Weibo is more representative compared to Tieba. Therefore, this article carries out the public opinion analysis by using Python crawler to obtain data on the topic of COVID-19 in Weibo. The methods we use include word frequency analysis tools, plug-ins in the ROST content mining system, and analysis interfaces in the Baidu Brain Al open platform. The purpose of this article is to analyze the mental health level of the public, such as nervousness, fear, panic, and anxiety. By experimental results on the relevant Weibo in February and March, we find that positive emotions stood at 14.64%,neutral emotion blog posts still accounted for 66.64% and negative emotions accounted for 18.72%.In the negative segment, the general negative emotions accounted for 12.485%,the moderate negative emotions accounted for 4.9%,and the users showed a high degree of negative emotions accounted for 0.455%.And then we roughly give the relevant strategies and suggestions for some groups which have the intense negative emotions. The limitation is that we can't give them some specific suggestions for different users for the time being, which needs further research in the future.

articleTitle: A Scientific Quantitative Analysis of Occupation Training and Education Driven by Information Technology Based on Big Data Analysis Technology and Visualization Software
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: At present, the information technology service industry is showing a good development trend. The rapid development of information technology has a significant impact on various fields. Driven by information technology, vocational training and education also enjoy the dividend brought by the development of information technology. In this context, vocational training provides more workers with endless opportunities, promotes the development of the labor market, and brings help to the wage problem of young people, especially some children. At the same time, vocational training is closely related to employment and education, which has brought certain changes to the youth and the labor market. Moreover, the state's attention to vocational training is also increasing, and vocational training is of great significance to the transformation of employment and education. However, there is a gap in the bibliometric analysis of this topic. Based on 694 articles retrieved from the web of science database from 1950 to 2020, this paper mainly reviews the highly cited literature on "vocational training", "employment", "education", "Youth", "labor market". By using big data analysis technology and visualization software, the author's key points such as keywords, main research institutions, countries, and publication sources are analyzed in detail. This paper makes a contribution to the literature of vocational training, employment, and education from the perspective of scientific measurement, to understand the impact of vocational training, education, and employment on youth and the labor market.

articleTitle: Design and thinking of “three districts and three states” electric power technology personnel training mode based on causal cycle analysis of the big data of education and training
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: This study integrates the relevant resources of enterprises, schools and government, closely follows the development needs of regional power enterprises, accurately grasps the characteristics of power grid in underdeveloped ethnic areas. Based on the big data statistics of ten years' Electric Power Education and training practice, using Vensim software, this paper constructs a causal cycle model driven by education and training, systematically summarizes and optimizes the talent transportation for Tibet, and forms a new model “Three fixed and one wide” talent training mode.

Author Keywords: electric power skilled personnel training mode
the management model of the standardization promotion path based on big data analysis

articleTitle: The construction and teaching reform of online open course
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: The construction of online open course integrates modem information technology with education and teaching in depth. According to the needs of school students or social learners, relevant specialized courses are set up to promote teaching fairness, advantageous resource sharing and cultural protection. The construction of online open curriculum is a systematic project, which needs to consider the coordination of all levels from teachers to students. The construction of online open course solves the problem that learners are restricted by learning time, space and learning threshold. In a word, online open course is formed on the basis of criticizing the traditional teaching mode of university, and it is the supplement and perfection of the traditional teaching mode. This paper uses Excel to make tables to make data analysis results more clear and intuitive. In addition, the data is processed and analyzed in depth through pivottables.

articleTitle: Research on the Application of Information Technology in Educational Decision
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: Information is the prerequisite for decision-making, and information technology is the guarantee for the effectiveness of scientific decision-making. Education is an important force to promote social progress, and the key to the development of education is to establish correct training goals. In the research of technical analysis of current education status, it is found that the dispersion of expected goals affects the realization of education goals. Only by considering the comprehensive effects of multiple factors and making reasonable decisions can we effectively avoid the deviation of training goals and enhance the effect of education.

articleTitle: Research on the training mode of electric power talents in ethnic areas with the Causal cycle model of the information and integration of production and education
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: Relying on the advantages of electric power enterprises in running schools, integrating enterprise, academic and political resources, we are committed to the pre-service and post service training of electric power talents in ethnic underdeveloped areas, build a lifelong learning platform, and help the development of electric power industry. Through the pre-service and post service talent training system, we can form a deep integration of teaching and training, which is in line with the integrity, pertinence, structure, dynamics and environment of talent training objectives, and feedback principle model runs through the whole process of electric power workers' career in underdeveloped areas. According to different post groups, based on information and integration of production and education, Vensim software is used to construct the causal cycle model of industry education integration, establish post curriculum system, implement target power skills course training and learning, and gradually improve the training and learning content.

Author Keywords: The training mode of electric power talents
ladder management model under the background of information

articleTitle: Research on Teaching Performance of Computer Course Based on Big Data
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: In the teaching of computer course, there are some problems such as students' poor practical ability, low learning enthusiasm and large assessment deviation. In this paper, through the collection, analysis and processing of the data of learners and learning context in practice teaching, the optimization of teaching design and implementation is realized, so as to effectively improve students' practical ability and learning enthusiasm, and correct assessment deviation.

articleTitle: PaintKG: the painting knowledge graph using bilstm-crf
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: One of the most important elements of culture is painting, which reserves ethnic and national immaterial relics. However, Chinese Web is currently short of a specialized knowledge graph on museums and it still crave accesses to effectually assimilate extensive types of discrete knowledge for applications. To facilitate museum knowledge sharing, we propose a painting knowledge graph, namely PaintKG, utilizing Bi-LSTM with CRF layer which obviously rises the F-l measure to recognize and extract knowledge and relations of different types of paintings and their painters from existing encyclopedia and unstructured Web text data and physically restore them in neo4j as graph data eventually. What's more, we depict and demonstrate typical scenarios of PaintKG and implement them by real-world applications, such as painting recommendation, painter entity association.

articleTitle: Measures to Promote Personnel Training from the Perspective of Periodical Construction Based on CiteSpace Method
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: Based on the analysis of the functions of some university journals in promoting personnel training, this paper further analyzes the problems existing in the construction of university journals in promoting personnel training, and analyzes the shortcomings of university journals in the level of digitization and informatization based on CiteSpace method. It is suggested that we should actively explore the mechanism of communication, research and demonstrate the setting of journal columns, formulate periodical topic planning scheme, strengthen the construction of periodical talent team, carry out the guidance of scientific paper writing, and adopt various digital and information methods to shorten the publication cycle, so as to make university journals a service platform to display the characteristics and achievements of discipline construction and talent training.

articleTitle: Research of Environmental Law Teaching Based on MOOC under COVID-19
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: The use of MOOC in environmental law teaching is an inevitable choice for environmental law education in the context of COVID-19. It is also an inevitable requirement for ecological civilization construction to adopt MOOC. The integrated online and offline teaching design, various and abundant teaching methods, a serious and lively teaching organization and management method based on motivation, and diversified teaching assessment and evaluation should be adopted.

articleTitle: Statistical Characteristics Analysis of Close Air Support Information Flow Pattern Based on Super-network
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: A stable and flexible information flow model is an important guarantee for the smooth implementation of close air support. Aiming at the problem of constructing the mode of close air support information flow, a “four-network” model of combat information flow based on the hyper-network is established. First, based on combat experience, the main combat forces and basic processes of close air support operations are analyzed, and combat nodes and information relationships are abstracted, so as to establish a close air support combat information flow super network model. After that, simulation experiments are carried out for the characteristics of super network nodes' super distribution. The simulation results show that the current close air support super-network has a certain degree of rationality and stability, and at the same time provides a reference for the next step to optimize the combat network structure.

articleTitle: Study on Case-based Teaching in Military Academies Based on Information Technologies
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: Case-based teaching, as a heuristic teaching method combing theory and practice and an important approach to practical course teaching, allows students to experience and discover knowledge in person directly and indirectly. A new implementation pattern has been provided for it with the constant promotion of information technologies and teaching platforms. This paper introduces the origin and development of case-based teaching, analyzes the connotation of teaching cases and case-based teaching deeply, discusses the methods of compiling teaching cases, and meanwhile puts forward effective measures for the implementation of case-based teaching based on information technologies in a targeted way under the background of military academies in combination with existing problems in the process of case-based teaching.

articleTitle: On Designing Experiment Teaching for Undergraduates’ Effective Learning of Logistics Distribution Center Planning and Management Course Based on PBL and BOPPPS
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: The experiment teaching plays an essential role in the undergraduates' effective learning of the logistics distribution center planning and management course. In this study, according to the characteristics of the course, the author proposes an experiment teaching design based on PBL and BOPPPS. In this design, considering the close connection between the contents of the course and various logistics planning problems, PBL is used to establish the framework of the experiment teaching of the logistics distribution center planning and management course. Then, to realize the PBL based experiment teaching framework, BOPPPS that carries out the PBL in a precise way is employed to design the specific teaching procedure for the experiment. The integration of PBL and BOPPPS provides a helpful design thinking to improve the effectiveness of the undergraduates' learning of the logistics distribution center planning and management course. It can also be applied in the course teaching of different specialties in the undergraduate education.

Author Keywords: logistics distribution center planning and management course

articleTitle: The Application of Analytic Hierarchy Process (AHP) in the Argumentation of the Rationality about Talent Training Program
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: The talent training plan is the overall design blueprint and implementation plan of talent training, and it is also the cornerstone of the cultivation of high-quality talents in universities. The formulation of high-quality talent training programs is the guarantee of professional construction and talent training quality. In this paper, the principle of Analytic Hierarchy Process(AHP) is used to construct an evaluation model for talent training programs, and the combination of qualitative and quantitative methods is used to rationally verify the rationality of the curriculum system in the talent training program, so as to select a more scientific, comprehensive and reasonable talent training and provide a basis for the society to cultivate high-quality talents.

articleTitle: Application of flipped classroom teaching mode based on MOOC concept in surgical nursing teaching
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: Objective: To investigate the application effect of flipped classroom teaching mode based on MOOC concept in surgical nursing teaching. Methods: According to the random number table method, the four classes of nursing undergraduate students of grade 2017 in our school of nursing were divided into two groups, 99 students in class 1 and class 2 as the experimental group, and 99 students in class 3 and class 4 as the control group. The control group used the traditional teaching mode, and the experimental group adopted the flipped classroom teaching mode based on the concept of MOOC. The assessment results, teaching effect evaluation, self-evaluation and teaching satisfaction of the two groups were compared. Results: The scores of theoretical knowledge and skill operation of the experimental group were significantly higher than those of the control group (P<; 0.05). The evaluation of the experimental group students on the teaching effect of liking teaching methods, improving enthusiasm, facilitating knowledge integration, improving participation consciousness, stimulating learning interest, improving information literacy, and good overall effect were better than those of the control group (P<; 0.05). The self-management ability, case analysis ability, team cooperation ability and scores of information literacy of the experimental group were significantly higher than those of the control group (P<; 0.05).
