The satisfaction of the experimental group was significantly higher than that of the control group (96.97% vs 85.86%, P<; 0.05). Conclusion: The flipped classroom teaching mode based on the concept of MOOC has good application effect in surgical nursing teaching, which can effectively stimulate students' interest in learning, enhance students' self-management ability and analysis ability, so as to improve students' learning performance and teaching satisfaction.

articleTitle: Pedestrian Attribute Recognition Based on Category Probability Loss Function
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: In order to improve the recognition performance of pedestrian attribute recognition algorithm, based on the DeepMAR algorithm framework, an end to end attribute recognition algorithm is proposed. Firstly, after the output of the ResNet50 backbone network, a lightweight channel attention module is added to weight high level semantic information to improve the accuracy of global attribute recognition, secondly, in terms of loss function, the network output category probability is used as an index to measure the difficulty of sample training, to adjust the weight of each attribute task in the loss function. The average accuracy rate of the experiment on the PETA dataset reached 85.28%, and the average accuracy rate on the PA100k dataset reached 79.49, which was 1.29% and 1.58% higher than the DeepMAR algorithm.

articleTitle: The Realization Method of Network Class Condition Monitoring System Based On Machine Vision
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: Aimed at the problem of teachers' inability to monitor students' class status during the Online Class, the Online Class atmosphere is generally not as good as the offline. This paper proposed a method based on CNN (Convolutional Neural Network) to detect and analyze students' class status. Based on the proposed method, we designed a software system for supervising students in online classes. The main function of the software system includes intelligent judgement of students' class state through the camera and real-time feedback status information. After unit tests and system tests, it is found that the method can well identify and determine the student's class status. The system proved that it can effectively improve the atmosphere and order for the Online Class.

articleTitle: A New Reduction Method Keeping Constant Rank for Fuzzy Soft Sets
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: The model of fuzzy soft set is increasingly applied to deal with uncertainty. This paper mainly introduces a new parameter reduction method keeping constant rank for fuzzy soft sets. After parameter reduction, this method guarantees that the final ranking results are in the same order as the original data sets. Finally, we draw a conclusion that the proposed algorithm is efficient.

articleTitle: Application of Artificial Intelligence Technology in English Learning Platform
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: With the deep integration of modern artificial intelligence information technology and English learning platforms, the widespread application of artificial intelligence technology has brought new opportunities for optimizing the process and experience of English learning. At the same time, it has provided a new platform with new learning experience for establishing an intelligent and personalized environment. This article starts from the perspective of artificial intelligence technology, and analyzes its integration and application strategies with learning platforms, and explores new learning experiences and improves learning effects.

articleTitle: The Effects of Meditative Elements in Games on Focused Attention
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: Meditation has proven health benefits on various cognitive abilities, including attention. However, past research has primarily focused on relatively traditional meditation training that requires guided lengthy practice over a period of time. An alternative approach is the short-term application of simple meditative elements, such as meditative music, meditative breathing, and meditative movements. This study investigated meditative elements' impacts on focused attention through a meditative game `PAUSE' on 32 participants. Performances in the Six-letter Cancellation Task (SLCT) were assessed both before and after a meditation session as a measurement for participants' level of Focused Attention. Data were analyzed using one-way repeated measures analysis of variance (ANOVA), Pearson's correlation test and a paired-sample t-test on Nvivo. The Result suggests significant improvements on focused attention from pre-test to post-test sessions. And such improvements have no correlations with the participants' age, gender and the duration of the meditative practice.

articleTitle: Research on the reform of foreign training teaching under the background of informatization
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: Foreign Training Teaching is an important part of teaching and training in our academy. In recent years, our college has adopted the strength of the whole academy, integrated various resources, and focused on improving the quality of teaching, and better met the needs of foreign training students. However, due to the particularity of foreign training teaching, our academy has always adopted the traditional teaching mode, which has been greatly challenged in the wave of educational informatization. We should take the initiative to meet the challenge and establish a student-centered and learning-oriented classroom teaching mode to realize educational informatization. Based on the practice and experience of foreign training, this paper introduces some effective teaching methods and teaching reform ideas, starting, from the characteristics and rules of foreign training and aiming at improving teaching quality.

articleTitle: Research On The Application of Big Data In Education Industry
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: As a new high-tech product of the 21st century, big data has been widely used in various industries, affecting people's daily life. Nowadays, big data has officially entered the education industry, changing the original traditional education model, and realizing education informatization. The combination of education and big data technology is conducive to in-depth mining of education data, making it develop in a personalized and modem direction.

articleTitle: Blended Teaching Model in Foreign Language Course - An Action Research based on the Analysis of SPSS
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: In order to promote teaching reform and improve teaching quality, the study uses the Internet technology to assist foreign language teaching. Three rounds of action research have been carried out to explore the blended teaching mode combining students' online self-study and offline project-based learning in the English course Intercultural Communication. With the interaction provided by the intelligent teaching platform named Super Star, the study tried to promote the cooperation between students (SS) as well as teachers and students (TS). SPSS is used to analyze the data formulated from the teaching platform such as learning behavior, learning achievement and of survey. The study found that the blended teaching model assisted students to evaluate their own academic performance and promote their autonomous learning ability.

articleTitle: Survey on Perceptions of College Students for Innovation and Entrepreneurship Based on Social Network Analysis
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: Innovation and entrepreneurship education in colleges in China are getting popularity. What kind of perceptual features do college students have for innovation and entrepreneurship? Using the method of social network analysis and taking all members of the team participating in the innovation and entrepreneurship competition of China Agricultural University in 2020 as the interviewees, this paper studies the perception of college students for innovation and entrepreneurship, including the perception of entrepreneurial ability structure and social support network perception. Through the degree centrality analysis of questionnaire data by UCINET, the results show that college students who participate in innovation and entrepreneurship practice have a higher awareness of the importance of public relations ability, market development ability, and resource allocation ability in the entrepreneurial ability structure. Regarding the perception of social support networks, the highest degree of centrality is all kinds of innovation and entrepreneurship competitions or practical projects, followed by family support networks such as entrepreneurial partners and entrepreneurial mentors.

articleTitle: Online Teaching Quality Analysis
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: With the rapid development of information technology, especially from the Internet to the mobile Internet, the way of life, work and learning across time and space has been created, and the way of knowledge acquisition has undergone fundamental changes. Accordingly, the proportion of online teaching is increasing, especially during the epidemic, almost all students participate in online learning. But for many teachers, online teaching is a new thing, and the quality of teaching is not high. Compared with the traditional teaching methods, online teaching has its own characteristics and rules. This paper analyzes the present situation of online teaching quality, discusses its advantages and disadvantages, and puts forward some suggestions to improve the teaching quality.

articleTitle: Research on Construction of “Double Tops” Characteristic Subject Group Model Based on Python and PSO
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: The evolution of war constantly gives birth to new technology, and the application of new technology constantly promote the iteration of war in return, which presents a spiral development process. In order to explore the applications of cutting-edge military technology, this paper designs the model of “Double Tops” characteristic subject group construction and studies the basic methods of constructing military and civilian characteristic subject group in Wuhan area by SWOT analysis method. This model focuses on analyzing the characteristic subject resources, regional strengths, policy advantages and the basic models of subject group construction in Wuhan area based on an universities' cooperation frequency matrix creating by particle swarm optimization, which can seize the opportunity of "Double Tops" subject group construction and realize the coordinated development of subject and regional strengths, forming the "Wuhan Mode" eventually.

articleTitle: Research on Education Model of “Internet Great Thought and Politics” in Higher Vocational Colleges Based on Big Data
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: Under the background of the Internet, the ideological and political education in higher vocational colleges should combine the theoretical teaching of daily ideological and political courses with the practical teaching activities, and construct the mode of practical education of ideological and political education, so as to realize the correct orientation and accurate education of ideological and political education. Based on this, this paper analyzes the present situation of ideological and political education in higher vocational colleges in the "Internet" era and the necessity of constructing the mode of ideological and political education, and combines the principles and objectives of constructing the "Internet ideological and political education" mode.

articleTitle: Research on the demand-driven O2O & BIA Blended Interactive Teaching Mode
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: With the rapid development and popularization of network technology, online education has been flourishing. More and more teachers began to explore and try to use online teaching to make up for the lack of classroom teaching. Blended teaching which can effectively integrate online and offline resources, give full play to the respective advantages of online teaching and classroom teaching has attracted more and more attention. This paper aiming at the problems existing in present teaching, takes students as the main body, demand as the driving force, and ability training as the main line, and takes the course “Web Design and Website Construction” as an example, proposes a demand-driven O2O & BIA blended interactive teaching model which can comprehensively improve the quality of talent cultivation.

articleTitle: Research on Data-based Curriculum Teaching Design under the Condition of Information : -Take the practical application of Rain Classroom in the course teaching of "Electronic Technology and Application" as an example
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: The popularization of smart classrooms and smart teaching tools in colleges and universities under the conditions of information technology, multi-channel interaction and panoramic data collection, drives continuous changes in teaching. Taking the application of intelligent teaching tool rain classroom in the course of Electronic Technology and Application as an example, this paper discusses the course teaching design of data-based precise learning situation analysis before class, accurate knowledge transfer in class, accurate knowledge consolidation after class, teaching evaluation and teaching reflection. It provides reference for the course teaching design under the condition of informationization.

articleTitle: Exploration on the mixed practice teaching methods of team experience under the training of new engineering talents
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: Facing the requirements of the first-class discipline of electronic information engineering and the construction of new engineering courses, this paper analyzes the characteristics of practice teaching under the background of new engineering, puts forward a team experience hybrid practical teaching method for new engineering talents training, expounds the implementation process of this method in detail, and applies the method to the practice project design course of electronic information engineering experimental class. The results show that this method can improve students’ self-learning ability, knowledge application ability, problem-solving ability, and engineering practice ability.

articleTitle: An SPSS Analysis of Blended Teaching in Tourism Translation
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: In the new era of industrial revolution 4.0 (IR.4.0), Internet plus education has become the inevitable trend of today's education. In this study, a questionnaire is designed and released to 191 students and the five-level Likert scale is used to set the answers for the single-choice questions. Using both the qualitative and quantitative methodology, a research is made on the tourism translation blended teaching mode, with an experimenting teaching of Xi'an special food and tourism text translation, which were made further well-known by the spreading of the film and television works Bailuyuan. The author intends to further study how to combine the Internet resources, network terminal platform and tourism translation teaching, in order to break the traditional teaching mode, and to improve tourism translation teaching effect. Using a professional platform named “Wenjuanxing” for data collection and questionnaire survey, this paper collected great amount of data. Then the professional statistics software SPSS (Statistical Product and Service Solutions) is employed to find out the current problems and situation of tourism translation teaching effect, then it applied blended teaching method to tourism translation teaching experiment. Lastly, questionnaire and topic talk are used to understand the effect of blended translation teaching experiment.

articleTitle: The Influence Factors Analysis of Instructional Interaction on College Students’ Satisfaction in Online Education based on the ACSI Model
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: This paper takes online education as the research background and takes instructional interaction as the research foothold. We draw on the mature customer satisfaction index model such as American Customer Satisfaction Index Model. Based on the ACSI model, we analyze the relevant factors of teaching interaction and try to find the influencing factors and construct the influence factors model of online interaction. In the next stage of research, our team will use methods such as questionnaires and data analysis to update the model and evaluate the quality of online learning.

articleTitle: Negative Transfer of Mother Tongue in English Writings of English Majors in Independent Colleges: Based on the Error Analysis with the Help of Correction Funciton of Microftword
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: In recent years, many researchers have studied the mode of thinking and the negative transfer of mother tongue that affect students' English writing, but little research has been done on independent college students. The author conducts the research on the students in Li Jiang College of GXNU which is an independent college. Based on the theories of Language Transfer, Contrastive Analysis, Error Analysis, the author attempts to study how negative transfer of Chinese influences EFL (English as a foreign language) learner in independent colleges on their English writing competence by analyzing the errors occurring in their English compositions with the help of correction function of Microsoft Word.

articleTitle: On Tibetan College Students’ Chinese Word Recognition Based on the High Speed Data Acquisition by SMI
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: Tibetan college students are typical trilinguists. Chinese, as their second language, is quite different from their mother tongue, Tibetan, in the rules of sound and spelling. So their Chinese word processing is quite different from monolinguists'. The article designed two experiments, including visual and auditory word recognition to check the processing order and processing load of sound, form and meaning in Chinese word recognition. Hi-speed of SMI was used to capture the data and SPSS was used to analyze the data. The experiments found that Tibetan college students' visual Chinese recognition was completed through the route of phonological mediation, while auditory Chinese recognition conformed to the theory of recombination of phonological representation The results showed that sound was crucial in the process of word recognition, so the teachers should take advantage of the feature to make their teaching more effective.

articleTitle: Application research of students’ Physical health data based on SPSS
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: Colleges and universities carry out physical health tests on students every year. The data are mainly from two aspects of body shape and body function to comprehensively evaluate students’ physical health level. Since 2014, a large number of physical health data have been accumulated. In order to use students’ physical health data to guide the reform of college PHYSICAL education curriculum, it is necessary to conduct big data analysis and research on students’ physical health data. SPSS software is used to analyze and study students’ physical health data, so as to fully understand the level and development trend of students’ physical health. With the data analysis results as the guide, scientific teaching materials are developed, reasonable assessment methods are constructed, and a complete teaching system is formed, so as to achieve the purpose of the practical application of students’ physical health data.)

articleTitle: The development of distance education in China
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: The “Internet +” strategy not only provides opportunities for the development of distance education, but also points out the direction for the development of distance education in terms of reform orientation. With the development of society, distance education is becoming more and more important in the process of building a learning society for all. Therefore, it is particularly necessary to recognize the theoretical system, research hotspots and research fronts of the evolution of China's distance education as a whole. This paper probes into the research hotspots and trends of distance education in China, and deeply analyzes and probes into the frontier research fields of distance education in China.

articleTitle: The Exploration of Introducing Ideological and Political Contents in the Teaching of Digital Signal Processing
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: The introduction of ideological and political contents in specialized course can not only cultivate students' virtues and values, but also improve the quality of courses and achieve the teaching objectives of professional education and moral education. The way to introduce ideology and culture in specialized courses is to guide students to plan their career on the basis of understanding national development. Taking “digital signal processing” course as an example, the following measures can be taken: guide students to look at specialized courses from the perspective of the state and society; all ideological and political contents are subject to a program: “digital signal processing” is the basis of information technology. In addition, teachers should take the initiative to learn to achieve self-development, but also should care about and help students' growth.

articleTitle: Practice of ideological and political education in the course of “R language foundation”
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: Comprehensively promoting the ideological and political construction of curriculum is an important strategic measure to implement moral education. This paper analyzes the objectives, contents, ideas, implementation and case teaching of Ideological and political education, and explores how to integrate ideological and political education into the course teaching. In the teaching practice of this course, rstuio development platform and mobile course learning platform are adopted. Ideological and political elements are also integrated into the course teaching. It can not only improve the professional and technical level of students, but also effectively improve the comprehensive quality of students, enhance professional quality, help students establish a correct outlook on life, cultivate patriotic feelings.

articleTitle: Study On The Proportion Of Paired Classroom Teaching Method To Different Undergraduate Students Based On Spss Software
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: With the deepening of China's higher education reform process, the student-centered concept has been recognized by all sectors of society. The segmented classroom teaching method is designed based on China's local experience, and has been gradually developed and achieved remarkable results in colleges and universities. However, there are differences in the learning status of students in different grades, including learning consciousness, learning habits, cultural background, and autonomous consciousness. This study uses SPSS software, using one-way analysis of variance, according to the differences of students in different grades, choosing different proportions and clarifying the responsibilities of teachers and students can better achieve the teaching goal of individualized teaching and achieve better learning results.

articleTitle: Tracking and application of IMM algorithm in mid-course of Booster-glide vehicle
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: The booster-glide vehicle is one of the most important research targets in recent years that can change orbit by maneuvering and glide by jumping during flight. This paper focuses on the research and analysis of tracking the midcourse booster-glide vehicle's trajectory. The interactive multi-model algorithm established by establishing the CS-CKF model and the free segment precise dynamics model is compared with the single CS-CKF model algorithm for analysis. The simulation results show that the interactive multi-model (IMM) algorithm based on CS-CKF and precision dynamics model has better performance in the midcourse tracking of the booster-glide vehicle.

articleTitle: Exploring the Application of English “Reading-Writing Integration” in Flipped Classroom Teaching Based on SPSS
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: The effective improvement of students' English reading and writing abilities is a major topic in academic English writing studies. Based on the concept of flipped classroom teaching, this study applies task-based approach. Combined with a computer-aided foreign language teaching platform, the organic integration of English reading and writing is proposed, and the adoption of the innovative teaching mode of “integration of reading and writing” is suggested. The whole teaching process is divided into three stages: pre-class, mid-class, and post-class, adopting SPSS as an analytical tool. The aim was both to improve students' critical thinking ability in reading and their comprehensive quality in English writing. Both can promote a good achievement for using the flipped classroom in managing academic English writing education in the English teaching reform.

articleTitle: The exploration of mixed experimental teaching in local college from the perspective of new engineering : Take electronic information engineering as an example
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: Local colleges should keep pace with the new engineering construction, push forward the reform of experimental teaching and professional engineering certification, improve personnel training, and serve economic and social development. The paper takes electronic information engineering as an example to point out that the experiment's teaching contents should be designed at different levels. The scheme should be selected scientifically, the equipment should be improved reasonably, and the evaluation mechanism should be revised. Our school implements the concept of “student-centered, output-oriented, continuous improvement,” which implements the experimental teaching mode of online and offline, virtual and reality, and constructs and improves the experimental teaching system suitable for local colleges and universities. It has effectively promoted the construction of new engineering and double first-class construction.

articleTitle: The Research on the Cultivation of Innovation Capabilities Supported by Information Technology : A case study of "soil mechanics and foundation engineering" course
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: With the goal of cultivating innovation capabilities, the overall course design of the "Soil Mechanics and Foundation Engineering" is reconstructed supported by information technology, including four parts as teaching modules, methods, activities and objectives. After the course is reorganized, the concept of flipped teaching is introduced in the classroom explanation, focusing on the training of students' thinking style and scientific literacy, which processes can also be implemented by computer programs. The introduction of scene-based activities, in a problem-driven way, could promote the teaching process. Based on the granular characteristics of the studied objects in this course, some programs of discrete element method may be applied in experiment and design teaching. As a result, our national development strategy of innovation and entrepreneurship is implemented in professional teaching.

articleTitle: Research on the Information Resource Management Model in the Chaos Organization : A Case Study on Land Development under the City Governing Counties
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: The vertical information circulation between local governments is asymmetric. Using the concept and method of chaotic organization, a resource-sharing information management model is constructed, in order to provide a path for the integration and sharing of information resources among vertical local governments. This article uses the evolutionary game method to describe the interest game of the city and county governments in the land market under the city governing counties system. By discussing the political relationship of the biologicalfoodchain between the politicized economic communities formed by the city and county governments, and combined with the current reality of unclear property rights information in China's land market, we establish a copydynamicmodel to analyze the behavior of government at city and county levels. Finally, it is concluded that through continuous learning and adjustment, the main body of the city and county governments will eventually reach a dynamic balance: the municipal government will eventually relax its strict supervision of the county government, and the county government will develop land with fuzzy property rights, seeking resources for county-level development.

articleTitle: ISEA Innovative Design to Promote Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: At present, foreign language learning in E-teaching settings is faced with the worrying phenomenon with “Four Nos”, namely “no content input, no clear viewpoints, no systematic expression, and no structured organization”. Therefore, it is inevitable to innovate teaching design to promote learners' deep learning. By analyzing teaching process, teaching methods, teaching stages and strategies, ISEA teaching design framework is innovatively put forward to regard critical thinking skills as the starting point and base its design on the teaching philosophy of “input-driven, combination of evaluation and learning, and output-oriented”, which is empirically verified with CTDI-CV results. ISEA teaching design is proved to promote the deep learning and innovate the learning effect of three expressions and two outputs the “meaningful, rational and logic” expressions and good oral and written outputs in foreign language learning.

articleTitle: Anomaly object detection in urban management surveillance video based on deep learning
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: In modem city management, the detection and identification of abnormal objects is particularly important. Random parking of non-motor vehicles is one of the common important problems in the process of smart city management. The traditional processing method is mainly to find abnormal targets manually and equipment, and then report to the urban management center for the next step. These methods are time consuming, laborious, and inefficient. In order to further improve the efficiency of urban management, this paper proposes an improved YOLOv3 urban management surveillance video anomaly object detection algorithm. On the basis of the original YOLOv3 framework, we use depthwise separable convolution to reduce the amount of model calculations and increase the detection speed. At the same time, the SE module is added to improve the network structure complexity and detection accuracy. Based on the actual surveillance video data, the detection speed of this algorithm is 4 fps faster than the traditional YOLOv3, and the recognition accuracy is improved by 3%.

articleTitle: The Application of PAD Class in the Design and Realization of Answering Device
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: In order to make better use of discussion-based teaching, improve teaching effects, and cultivate students’ innovative thinking, the article first analyzes the problems in the teaching of “Electronic Technology and Application”, and briefly introduces the innovative teaching method of “PAD class”, puts forward the practical application of “PAD class” in the integration of theory and practice in “Electronic Technology and Application”. The application of this teaching method improves students’ learning initiative and cultivates their self-learning ability and innovative practical ability.

articleTitle: On the Application Analysis and Innovation of New Media of Party Building in Colleges and Universities Based on SPSS
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: The development of new media has brought both opportunities and challenges to primary-level party organization of colleges and universities. The promotion of information technologies, which plays a key role in primary-level party organization, are being increasingly important in the new era. This paper started from the necessity of new media in party building in colleges and universities, and analyzed the status quo and problems in the era of new media. By combining with information technologies and the actual conditions of primary-level party organization, spss22.0 software was used to process the survey data of grassroots Party organizations in colleges and universities, In order to further improve the level of grassroots party building and management in colleges and universities, countermeasures such as 020 and DIY working mode and optimization mechanism are put forward.

articleTitle: Research on Practical Teaching System Model Based on Modem Apprenticeship
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: The modern apprenticeship from a micro perspective focuses on the talent training model. Modem apprenticeship is based on learning in the work process, with work-study alternation as the main form, and knowledge and skills as the training goal. It is necessary to highly align the concepts and methods of modem apprenticeship with vocational education, and inject relevant concepts of modern apprenticeship into vocational education, and put it into practice, which is inseparable from practical teaching. The article embeds the concept of modern apprenticeship into all levels from the perspective of the practical teaching system structure, in order to provide new ideas and inspiration for the existing practical teaching.

articleTitle: Multi Dimensional Construction and Implementation of “ACCESS” Course Online Classroom Teaching Exploration and Practice
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: Based on the major teaching and research projects and teaching resources in the special period of the epidemic, combined with the intelligent teaching tools of rain class and Tencent classroom, the online access course teaching scheme was constructed and implemented in multi dimensions. This paper first introduces the use method of course teaching resources and platform, and then expounds the construction and implementation process of each module teaching system of "before class, in class and after class" in online classroom. Finally, the assessment results of the course are evaluated to verify the substantial equivalence between online classroom and offline classroom teaching. The implementation of the online course not only promotes the students' mastery and application of access database knowledge, but also relieves the difficulties in the period of school delay due to the epidemic situation. It explores a better way and mode for online teaching, which plays a strong role in promoting the teaching effect, and also provides some experience and reference for the implementation of other online courses.

articleTitle: Exploration on the Construction of Teaching and Research Group under Background of New Engineering
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: The research is based on the background of new engineering, taking the teaching and research group of software engineering of Anhui Sanlian University as an example, this study is devoted to exploring a feasible way of industry-education integration, students participate in the project research and teaching effect for teachers for construction of the teaching and research group. Furthermore, further work is put forward to promote the deep integration of information education technology with smart campus, to achieve smart management of the teaching and research group gradually.

articleTitle: Integration of Traditional Culture into Commodity Subject Teaching Material Innovation under Multimedia Information Technology
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: China is currently in a critical period of economic and social reform. In order to meet the needs of social reforms and cultivate new business talents that meet the requirements of the times, higher vocational colleges must start with teaching materials and optimize and adjust business teaching materials with the help of multimedia information technology. New teaching concepts and technologies are integrated for teaching. In view of this, this article mainly analyzes and discusses how to use multimedia information to innovate commodity subject teaching materials.

articleTitle: Spssau analysis of the application of new media technology in ideological and political theory teaching
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: As a key course to implement the fundamental task of moral education and educating people, it is imperative to reform ideological and political education by using new media teaching methods. We use the SPSSAU analysis software, cluster analysis and association analysis methods for a comprehensive analysis of the survey data, the conclusions are as follows: Application of multimedia teaching means in education courses teaching time feeling strong, rich information, and facilitate the advantages of the autonomous learning, at the same time there is also a high cost, is not conducive to the teachers and students face to face with communication, may become a mere formality, etc, in the aspect of optimization strategy to deal with the new media education with traditional teaching, the universality and particularity, the relationship between hardware construction and software construction, to improve education courses in the teaching of ideological content, theoretical and affinity, targeted.

Author Keywords: new media ideological and political course

articleTitle: Review of the Technology Application in Music Teaching and Learning
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: With the rapid development of technology and its wide application in music classrooms in the 21st Century, technology has brought certain changes to music education. At this time, the trend of integration of technology and music teaching and learning will continue. This article mainly reviews technology in music education. The author mainly analyzes the following three aspects: (1) The change of technology in the efficiency of student learning in music courses includes two parts: interaction and cooperation; (2) Technology changes in the learning concepts of music teachers and students; (3) A blended learning environment with technology-based music classrooms. Based on the findings of this review, the researcher believes that the use of technology in music classrooms can improve learning efficiency, cooperation, and interaction. In addition, the creation of technological music classrooms will subtly influence teachers and students, which can also affect their teaching and concepts. Also, the integration of technology into the music classroom has produced a virtual-real mixed learning environment, which has also changed the role of teachers. However, there may be some problems that need to be paid attention to. For example, teachers may need to think about the feasibility issues (e.g., technical equipment), their own technical mastery, and student acceptance. Therefore, there is still a long way to study the application of technology to music teaching. Even though technology brings a lot of conveniences, the problem of when large-scale technology is popularized and used remains to be studied. Besides, with the influence of online education under COVID-19 situations, the development of online classrooms will be greatly promoted, and the development of online music classrooms is also worth studying.

articleTitle: Research on the Integrated Construction of Electronic Technology Courses for the Cultivation of Applied Talents in Higher Vocational Colleges
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: Under the new situation, higher vocational and technical education should highlight the characteristics of vocational education and innovate curriculum and teaching models in terms of cultivating high-quality applied and skilled talents. This paper takes the construction of electronic technology courses compulsory for higher vocational communication and electronics majors as the main research object, comprehensively analyzes the current situation of course teaching, focusing on reshaping the course system, optimizing course content, innovation in teaching organization forms, environmental resources and teacher construction, etc., and deeply discusses the integrated construction strategy of electronic technology courses in higher vocational colleges, and put forward the curriculum reform methods suitable for the characteristics of higher vocational student. This method can provide useful reference for the cultivation of applied talents in higher vocational colleges.

articleTitle: Reform Research and Practice of Army Equipment Teaching Model Based on Education Informatization
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: According to the new requirements and characteristics of higher education reform, with the teaching principle of “focus on combat, center on the army, and highlight practice”, we actively explored the informatization reform of equipment courses and took full advantage of the modern informatization approach, namely, “one platform and four systems”. Not only have we solved the traditional teaching problems, but we also have improved the efficiency of teaching and training. After five years of exploration and practice, we have gradually formed a new mode of teaching equipment courses, that is, “integrating theory and practice, combining the virtual and real training, and supplementing the real with the virtual”. In doing so, the “teaching, practice, view, learning, and evaluation” system in higher education has been transformed, which is of great practical significance for the cultivation of applied equipment talents.

articleTitle: “Three Enters” work of Xi Jinping Thought on Socialism with Chinese Characteristics for a New Era (2017-2018)–Data analysis based on Corpus
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: This paper adopts the self built corpus and uses the word frequency analysis method of the corpus to analyze the “Three Enters” work of Xi Jinping Thought on Socialism with Chinese Characteristics for a New Era in 2017-2018 years. The research finds that the main motivation of the study is fund projects. The researchers have a relatively unified understanding of the meaning of “Three Enters” work; the researchers' research reflects the “Three Enters” work in the time period. Teachers' theoretical teaching ability needs to be strengthened; student-centered teaching concept has become the mainstream; highly integrated with information technology is the general trend.. The main safeguard measures are the attention of the Party committee and the improvement of relevant evaluation mechanism, “Three-wide Education” system has been formed.

Author Keywords: Xi Jinping Thought on Socialism with Chinese Characteristics for a New Era

articleTitle: Adversarial Learning Siamese Network for Object Tracking
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: Aiming at the problem that the object tracking algorithm based on the siamese network is difficult to effectively extract the salient features of the object due to the shallow AlexNet. In this paper, we propose a siamese network tracking algorithm based on adversarial learning (AL-SiamFC). First, we construct the convolutional backbone network based on the attention dropout layer, and then let the network learn the salient features of the object in the form of adversarial learning during offline training. Finally, the trained tracking network is evaluated using the tracking benchmark data set OTBIOO, and the attention dropout layer is not used in the online tracking. The experimental results show that, without significantly reducing the tracking speed, the success rate and precision rate of the AL-SiamFC are increased by 3% and 2% compared with the SiamFC, and the adaptability and robustness have been significantly improved.

articleTitle: The Future Education of Teenagers: The Emotional Intelligence and Multidimensional Anxiety Symptoms Based on Meta-analysis of Regulation
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: Objective Based on the multi-dimensional perspective, the anxiety symptoms of adolescents in real life can be divided into social anxiety symptoms and academic anxiety symptoms. Meta-analysis technology is used to study the relationship between adolescents' emotional intelligence and multidimensional anxiety symptoms, in order to alleviate adolescents' anxiety symptoms, improve students' mental health level at all levels and all kinds of schools in the future education, and provide theoretical value and practical significance for teaching and research in related fields of school mental health in the future education. Methods First of all, Chinese and English databases are searched, such as CNKI, Google Scholar. Chinese search words include emotional intelligence, anxiety, social anxiety, academic anxiety, test anxiety. English search words include emotional intelligence, anxiety, social anxiety, academic anxiety, test anxiety, and anxiety symptoms. Secondly, manually search relevant journals. Finally, this study consults the references of related articles to further supplement the literature. CMA2.0 (Comprehensive Meta- analysis), SPSS 26 and EXCEL were used for data processing. The specific analysis process is as follows: the correlation coefficient between emotional intelligence and anxiety is used as the effect value statistic, and then the effect value of each independent sample is synthesized into an effect value, the fail safe N and funnel plot are used as the test standards. Results in this paper, 36 empirical studies (64 effect values, 21645 samples) were conducted. There is a negative relationship among the general anxiety symptoms, social anxiety and academic anxiety of adolescents' emotional intelligence. The correlation coefficient and 95% CI are-0.325 (-0.394, -0.253), -0.287 (-0.371, -0.200), -0.295 (-0.406, -0.175). And to a large extent, cultural situation (East, West), group level (college students, primary and secondary school students), gender differences play a regulatory role in the relationship between the two, in which the correlation between emotional intelligence and anxiety symptoms is stronger in the East, between college students and between female groups than in other situations. All the articles included were impartial. Conclusion The relationship between emotional intelligence and anxiety symptoms of adolescents at home and abroad will be affected by cross-cultural situation, gender and group level. In the future education of teenagers, we should pay attention to the cultivation of emotional intelligence.

articleTitle: Face-to-face classes hijacked by COVID-19: what and how HEI instructors want to learn for online teaching
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: Upon the forced interruption of face-to-face classes because of COVID-19, HEIs moved online to deliver courses in the spring semester of the 2019-2020 academic year. A survey of 108 instructors from HEIs in Wuhan, Hubei, China was carried out to Figure out the situation or perception of HEI instructors before, during and after the online transition. The research reveals a severe lack of online teaching experience among teaching staff prior to the transition but they got prepared mainly by self-directed learning or attending training programs. In the pandemic semester, about two thirds of respondents used five-streamed delivery while the rest employed asynchronous teaching and the most-frequently-encountered problems were internet connection failure, fake attendance and poor involvement of students. Almost all respondents agreed upon an investment in and speed up of the development of online teaching resources in the post-pandemic period and their primary concerns for training lied in how to engage students, how to design in-class activities and online course assessment. As for forms of training, smaller and more focused programs like small workshops or short training videos were more favored by the respondents. The research also reveals some interesting differences between different categories of respondents.

articleTitle: Online English Learning Efficiency of Adults from Different Ages in Mainland, China
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: With the development of globalization and technology, people in China desire to acquire authentic English, for study, foreign tourism, and academic exchanges. Not only the teenage students, but also the adults have a strong desire to study English. There is no denying that online English education is one of the most economical and practical approaches to study English. This paper explores the online English learning efficiency of adults among different ages. The research focuses on three age groups of adults, which are 18-28 years old, 28-45 years old and 45-60 years old. Through a series of online questionnaires and group discussions with online English teachers and students, it is found that the adults from 28 to 45 years old are the most effective group in online English learning than that of age group of 18-28 and 45-60. This research has a significant impact on the learning habits and characteristics of adults from different ages, which can guide them to select the best English learning methods. It also fills the gap of online English Learning efficiency of adults from different ages.

articleTitle: Practice of Online Open Course Construction for Application-oriented Undergraduate Automobile Major Based on OBE
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: As an important part of the education informationization construction during the 13th Five-Year Plan period of the Ministry of Education, the online open course is of great practical significance to students, schools and teachers, and its importance is even more evident through the development of courses during the epidemic period. Combined with the construction experience of two provincial online open courses and OBE theory, taking the online open course construction of "automobile chassis structure" in Ordos Institute of Technology as an example, this paper summarizes the experience and construction methods of online open course construction, so as to promote the development of practical education and teaching informatization.

articleTitle: Research on Influencing Factors of Postgraduate Education Quality in Research Institutes Based on Structural Equation Modeling
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: As the highest level of academic education, the quality of postgraduate education is related to the cultivation of high-quality talents. As an important part of higher education, scientific research institutes play an indispensable role in cultivating professional talents in specific industries. However, compared with universities, there is still a certain gap. Aimed at student training in research institutes, questionnaire investigation and structural equation modeling are used to analyze key factors affecting the quality of education and measure the influence degree. In conclusion, measures and suggestions are put forward such as strengthening tutor selection and assessment, improving efficiency and effectiveness of management and building perfect curriculum system, which is combined with the application of informatization technology, so as to promote scientific research investment and essay writing quality, thus enhancing theoretical knowledge ability and the improvement of scientific literacy.

articleTitle: Research on the Blended teaching of computer basic and application
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: In order to improve the learning effect of non-conmissioned officers. Based on the BOPPPS model, a Blended teaching design and practical exploration have been carried out on the course of the non-commissioned officers “Computer Basics and Applications”. Practice has shown that the teaching mode is effective and highly operable.

articleTitle: Multi user multi keyword searchable encryption scheme supporting user authorization
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: In the big data environment of cloud computing, searchable encryption enables users to selectively access ciphertext data while improving data security. The existing multi-keyword-based encryption schemes have great shortcomings in terms of too large trapdoors and not supporting dynamic authorization of multiple users. Based on this, this paper proposes a multi-user multi-keyword searchable encryption scheme that supports user authorization. This solution supports the data owner to authorize users who access the data, and realizes that the authorized user sends the request for accessing the data to the data owner. Finally, the data owner generates a trapdoor and sends it to the server, and the server sends the result to the user after retrieval. In addition, this solution supports multi-users to dynamically add or withdraw users to ensure data security. This scheme proves that IND-CKA is safe and has the security of keyword trapdoor.

articleTitle: Innovation Ability Cultivation Scheme Based on CDIO of The Applied Undergraduates and The Effect Analysis using SPSS
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: Based on the CDIO concept, this study explored the individualized cultivation scheme of innovation ability for application-oriented undergraduates. The project aims to promote the reform of education, teaching and talent training mode, continuously improve the innovative practice ability and scientific research accomplishment of undergraduates, and broaden their horizon. On the one hand, this project can provide a large number of excellent graduate students for the establishment of the integrated application-oriented talent training system of `higher vocational specialist - Applied Technical Undergraduate - Professional degree graduate'. On the other hand, the program can also improve the competitiveness of college graduates for direct employment in professional counterpart jobs. At the same time, this project explores the leading role of undergraduate tutors in the personalized training of students, and promotes the close combination of undergraduate training and teacher research. The data of the last five years were recorded and analyzed by SPSS. The results show that through long-term accumulation effect, high-level innovation achievements are continuously accumulated and the quality of achievements is also continuously improved.

articleTitle: Research on the Quality of the Master Training in the Context of Big Data———Based on the Economic Model of Public Trust
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: With the development of my country's information technology, it can be found that my country's master's degree is increasing in a certain proportion every year. Affected by the novel coronavirus epidemic, policies will be introduced in 2020 to increase the enrollment expansion of masters by 20%. Big data has found that the proportion of enrollment expansion has increased significantly compared with previous years. The large increase in the proportion of enrollment has raised concerns about whether the gold content of master's degree will decline in this era of big data. Based on the SPSS of statistical analysis by network computers, this paper constructs an economic model to explore whether the current quality of master's training can solve the public's concerns, and thus introduce educational policies that are in line with the development of information technology.

articleTitle: A Study of Construction of Mobile MOOC for General Education in Colleges and Universities in the Internet Era
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: Recently, the construction of Mobile MOOC for general education in colleges and universities in the Internet era has been extensively explored in academia in China. The investigation of the construction of Mobile MOOC reveals a significant significance to improve the quality of general curriculum in colleges and universities, share the resources of general curriculum in colleges and universities, and cultivate the core qualities of college and university students. Based on the defined core concepts, this paper expounds the importance of the issues, and presents that Mobile MOOC of general education in colleges and universities in the Internet era should be established based on the philosophy of focusing on the development of college and university students, the establishment of the elements of Mobile MOOC of general education, and the improvement of teaching abilities of college and university teachers and the management system for the general curriculum, so as to provide effective references for the scientific decisions on the construction of Mobile MOOC of general education in colleges and universities in the Internet era.

articleTitle: Characteristics and Enlightenment of MIT Computer Science and Engineering Courses Based on Analytic Hierarchy Process Model
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: Computer science and engineering is one of the first-class majors of MIT. The study aims to find out the enlightenment of MIT's computer science and engineering curriculum and talent training model for other modern universities. Based on the analytic hierarchy process model, this paper analyzes the model and characteristics of the setting of MIT computer science and engineering courses and summarizes the enlightenment of courses setting model, which has strong significance for optimizing the engineering curriculum system and improving the quality of talent training of other modern universities.

articleTitle: Research on the Construction of Library Chinese Information Resources Based on Citation Analysis
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: This paper uses the citation analysis method to analyze the Chinese citations of the Chinese core journal articles published by the personnel of the unit in the past ten years, revealing the protection of different types of Chinese collection resources, in order to provide corresponding references for the construction of library resources.

articleTitle: Research on the Reform of Mixed Teaching Mode
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: Blended teaching mode is one of the trends in higher education reform in recent years. The article studies the connotation of blended teaching, analyzes the organizational form and requirements of blended teaching, explores the problems in the implementation of blended teaching, and proposes relevant measures to strengthen the reform of blended teaching.

articleTitle: Teaching exploration of piano playing and singing based on big data analysis
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: Under the background of “Internet”, cloud computing and big data technology have been applied in various fields, including piano teaching, which can show better teaching effect. With the help of big data piano “playing” teaching software and previous practical work experience, this paper expands the piano playing time and space for students to develop a greater platform. It is precisely because of the characteristics of big data that the application of modern technology becomes a reality and promotes the students' learning motivation of piano singing.

articleTitle: Research on Peer Education Based on FIF Oral Practice APP
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: Based on the autonomous practice by FIF oral training app, this paper discusses the specific implementation and effect of peer education in non English major college students from the formulation of peer education plan, the establishment of team management mechanism and the selection and training of student tutors. The results show that the implementation of peer education can effectively mobilize the enthusiasm of students to practice oral English, increase their time investment in oral English practice, and promote the accuracy of pronunciation, the fluency of reading as well as the output of language. It is proved that peer education is a new way of student education, which can be applied and promoted.

articleTitle: Spss Statistical Modeling Analysis Of College Students’ Physical Fitness Test Satisfaction
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: As the health problems of college students are getting more and more attention, a questionnaire survey is conducted on college students, mainly to investigate their satisfaction with physical fitness test. Through the questionnaire survey, a large number of data was collected. Then SPSS statistical modeling method was used to analyze the collected data, and reliability and validity test, factor analysis and sequence analysis were adopted. Through big data analysis, it is found that the surveyed college students attach great importance to physical fitness test, but are not satisfied with the physical fitness test of their school.

articleTitle: Study on the effect of video learning sequence on eye movement behavior and learning outcome of learners
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: The influence of presentation sequence of learning materials on learners' cognition and learning effect is an important issue in the field of education. However, in the field of e-learning, there is little research on the sequence of material presentation. This paper aims to explore the influence of learning sequence on learners' learning effect and eye movement behavior. T-test was used to analyze the academic performance of the subjects participating in the specific experiment, and the eye movement data were analyzed by one-way ANOVA. The experimental results show that, at the same level of prior knowledge, the video learning sequence has no effect on the learning effect, but the learning sequence has an impact on the eye movement behavior and psychological cognitive load of learners in the learning process.

articleTitle: A study on the cultivation model of intercultural communicative competence in foreign language teaching
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: With the continuous change of the world situation, English is becoming more and more important as an international language. With the full coverage of globalization, there are more and more exchanges between different cultures, and the cultivation of cross-cultural communicative competence of foreign language talents has become increasingly prominent. With the continuous increase of foreign exchange, there is a growing demand for foreign language talents with certain intercultural communicative competence. In recent years, the cultivation of intercultural communicative competence has become the focus of foreign language teaching in China. Therefore, this paper makes an in-depth study on the cultivation model of intercultural communicative competence in China. This study mainly conducts literature survey and questionnaire survey on the current situation of the cultivation model of cross-cultural communication ability in China, analyzes its advantages and disadvantages in detail, summarizes its shortcomings, and then puts forward relevant suggestions on the cultivation model of cross-cultural communication ability in China on the basis of the analysis and research, so as to provide a reference for the further development of China's cross-cultural communication ability training model Some references.

articleTitle: Research on Satisfaction of High School Mathematics Teaching Efficiency Based on OBE -Take Gansu and Qinghai Tibetan Ethnic Middle Schools as examples
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: Taking the three Tibetan middle schools in Gansu and Qinghai-Tibet areas as examples, there are many reasons for the poor efficiency of high school math classroom teaching. We are based on OBE teaching philosophy, the investigation and analysis were carried out from three dimensions: interest and feelings of mathematics learning, motivation of mathematics learning, and attitude of math teaching, and use the fuzzy comprehensive analysis method to conclude that the satisfaction of teaching efficiency is general. Based on the OBE teaching philosophy, student-centered and reverse-designed teaching plans should start from the following aspects: Stimulate interest and set reasonable goals; student-centered, positioning the driving force; with a smile and friendly get along.

articleTitle: Minimal Memory Consumed Pipeline Filter and Its Implementation on FPGA
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: Pipeline filter is a classical small target detection algorithm for infrared system. However, when the image size is large, the algorithm consumes too many memory resources, which makes it difficult to apply on hardware platforms with limited storage resources. In this paper, a minimal memory consumed pipeline filter is proposed, and its implementation approach based on FPGA is given. This approach stores the measurements list and then restores the original image instead the traditional way of storing the original image directly, which greatly saves the storage resource requirement. A memory consumption comparison between the proposed approach and the traditional approach is given, and the effectiveness of this algorithm is verified on FPGA development board.

articleTitle: A general evaluation method of university curriculum summative text based on optimized BERT model
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: At present, many curriculum evaluations in universities are based on students' summative texts of courses. However, because the evaluation methods are based on Teachers' subjective judgment and time-consuming, they are unstable and inefficient. In order to solve this problem, this paper proposes a text classification model based on optimized BERT (bidirectional encoder representations from transformers) for summative text evaluation of university courses. In this model, the deep dynamic representation of word vector is extracted by using the BERT pre-trained language model, and then the summative text analysis is carried out by using the Mean-Max-pooling method. Finally, the text classification is completed by using the sigmoid function and threshold fine-tuned. The experimental result shows that the AUC (Area Under Curve) of this model is 12.5% higher than that of the RNN(Recurrent Neural Network) and CNN(Convolutional Neural Network) model, and the model is effective.

articleTitle: Research on the Cultivation of the Core Competences and Values of Information Technology for Normal School Students Based on Maker Education
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: With the advent of Education Information 2.0, the era puts forward new requirements for normal school students' information technology capabilities. This paper explores the cultivation of the core competences and values of the information technology of normal school students amid the big data, proposes a teaching strategy based on maker training and carries out the implementation of computer network-assisted teaching, and verifies the effectiveness of teaching strategy by analyzing the effect of the core competences and values of the student's work and deepening the curriculum reform in the information age.

articleTitle: The application of MATLAB teaching in the cultivation of non-professional quality of undergraduates
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: The development speed of education informationization is faster and faster. How to make better and more efficient use of this tool to improve the comprehensive quality of talents is an important research topic for every educator. The cultivation of non-professional quality of college undergraduates is directly related to the employment of students and the good or bad of their future life. A lot of good qualities are not only built on a few of campus activities and a little time to participate in several kinds of comptitive events. This paper discusses the attempts of colleges and universities teachers to infiltrate the cultivation and training of non-professional quality by rationally and skillfully using the teaching opportunity of professional courses of MATLAB.

articleTitle: Research on the construction of SPOC teaching system based on rain class in post MOOC Era
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: As a large-scale online teaching model, MOOC has been widely used in classroom teaching reform in recent years. Despite its many advantages, it also has disadvantages such as lack of teacher-student interaction and rapid decline of learning enthusiasm. SPOC teaching mode helps to make up for these shortcomings and further promote the integration of MOOC and traditional classroom teaching. For this purpose, this paper discusses the relevant methods of constructing SPOC teaching system under the support of rain class technology, and provides a new idea for classroom teaching reform.

articleTitle: Optimal Maximal Entanglement EAQECCs constructed by LCD caps in PG(3,9) and PG(4,9)
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: Entanglement-assisted quantum error correcting codes (EAQECCs) play an important role against errors in quantum information system. Especially maximal entanglement EAQECCs can achieve a higher rate and have better noise suppression capabilities. In this paper, LCD caps in PG(3, 9) and PG(4, 9) are discussed and used to construct maximal entanglement EAQECCs with distance 4. According to Hamming bound, most of these results are optimal.

articleTitle: Ways to Enhance the Influence of Academic Journals Based on MOOC Resources
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: In the era of Internet media convergence, to further enhance the influence of academic journals in colleges and universities, the first thing is to pay close attention to the quality construction, strengthen the program planning, expand the quality of contributions, shorten the publishing cycle, and play the role of editorial board, strengthen the editorial department team construction and other directions. Secondly, it is necessary to explore a variety of communication channels and strengthen them in the direction of precise positioning of traditional publishing, develop digital publishing model, joining in digital publishing platform, and using academic conferences to expand publicity channels. Academic journals in colleges and universities especially can take advantage of unique conditions and campus MOOC resources to explore new ways to accurately and effectively enhance the brand effect and influence of journals through situational intervention.

articleTitle: Talking about the current situation and countermeasures of mathematics information teaching in middle schools in Gannan Tibetan area
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: With the continuous deepening of “Internet + education”, informatization teaching in ethnic areas has become the focus of the Ministry of Education in recent years. In order to understand the current situation of mathematics informatization teaching in middle schools in Gannan Tibetan area, the basic situation of mathematics teaching in a middle school in Gannan Tibetan area was investigated. Mainly from the two aspects of mathematics teaching content and teaching methods to analyze the factors that affect and restrict the development of mathematics informatization teaching in middle schools in Gannan Tibetan area.

articleTitle: Focusing on the "14th Five-Year Plan"’: Analysis of Some Problems of Teachers’ Ethics in Physical Education Teachers Based on Data Visualization
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: 2020 is not only the closing year of the 13th Five-Year Plan (2016-2020), but also the year of the 14th Five-Year Plan. This paper uses the methods of literature, mathematical statistics and other research methods to sort out the relevant research results of "physical education teachers' ethics" during the 13th Five-Year Plan, and summarizes the common problems existing in the teachers' ethics of physical education in China. The results show that there are some problems such as lack of sense of mission, lack of professional self-identity, lack of humanistic care, weak sense of lifelong learning, lack of rigorous teaching and poor academic consciousness.

articleTitle: Comment and Improvement on Two Aggregate Signature Schemes for Smart Grid and VANET in the Learning of Network Security
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: Smart substation and Vehicular Ad-Hoc Network (VANET) are two important applications of aggregate signature scheme. Due to the large number of data collection equipment in substation, it needs security authentication and integrity protection to transmit data. Similarly, in VANET, due to limited resources, it has the needs of privacy protection and improving computing efficiency. Aggregate signature scheme can satisfy the above these needs and realize one-time verification of signature for multi-terminal data collection which can improve the performance. Aggregate signature scheme is an important technology to solve network security problem. Recently, many aggregate signature schemes are proposed which can be applied in smart grid or VANET. In this paper, we present two security analyses on two aggregate signature schemes proposed recently. By analysis, it shows that the two aggregate signature schemes do not satisfy the security property of unforgeability. A malicious user can forge a signature on any message. We also present some improved methods to solve these security problems with better performance. From security analysis to improvement of aggregate signature scheme, it is very suitable to be an instance to exhibit the students on designing of security aggregate signature scheme for network security education or course.

articleTitle: The practice and exploration of Internet online education
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: "Internet plus” has profound influence on educational resources, educational institutions, learning modes and teaching modes, and brings about changes in educational philosophy. In recent years, colleges and universities have paid more attention to the construction of online courses, such as flipped classroom, micro class teaching, MOOC of China University, which are all new forms of education popular in Colleges and universities. However, generally speaking, online teaching is still in the primary stage of exploration. At present, online teaching has been transformed from the auxiliary means of classroom teaching to the main teaching means. How to ensure the teaching of online teaching Learning effect and quality are the important contents of school education.
