This paper summarizes the current situation of online teaching in our school in recent months, aiming to make a contribution to the construction and development of online courses in the future.

articleTitle: Probit Model Based Research on the Influence of Social Capital to Psychological Capital of Children from Single Parent Families: : Empirical Analysis based on CHARLS Data of China
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: By using STATA software, Probit modeling is applied to explore the influence of social capital on psychological capital of children from single parent families in China. Based on CHARLS dataset, 552 single parent families and 1,140 families in Shandong Province is studied. Based on social capital theory, three hypothesis are developed and STATA software is applied to test the hypothesis by Probit modeling method. The model results show how different dimensions of social capital affect the psychological capital of children from single parent family. It is found that children from single parent families are more likely to be bullied at school and have less happiness in school. Compared with the two-parent family, the social capital of children from single parent family is significantly lower in terms of family, peer, school and community levels. In single parent families, peer and community social capital have more significant effect on school happiness than family social capital; family, school, peer and community social capital have significant effect on school happiness in two-parent family. Although the difference of family structure has no significant effect on the psychological capital of children in Shandong Province, the enhancement of social capital level in different dimensions still has a significant effect on the improvement of children's sense of happiness in school. Based on Probit modeling, this study is of great significance for the construction of education network and social support system for children from single parent families through improving different social capital.

articleTitle: A Novel Geometric Information Retrieval Tool for Images of Geometric Diagrams
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: The description of geometric knowledge in geometric documents often uses a combination of text and diagrams. Compared to the text describing knowledge in natural language or mathematical language, the diagrams may contain even more geometric information, and the recognition of them is a challenge. This paper mainly studies how to automatically extract planar geometric information from images of geometric diagrams. We firstly explore the classification of usual images of diagrams, secondly describe a general framework for geometric information retrieval from images of diagrams, then design and implement a geometric information retrieval tool-GIRTOOLS based on the framework. Finally, experiments demonstrate the feasibility and effectiveness of the approaches implemented in GIRTOOLS. This work may have potential applications in geometry education and knowledge discovery.

articleTitle: The Element Mining of MOOC Teaching Satisfaction Based On Online Comments
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: Based on the perspective of learners, this paper makes a systematic study on the evaluation elements of teaching satisfaction, and collects a total of 276389 online comment text data from the MOOC (Massive Open Online Courses) network of Chinese universities in a certain period time. Ten elements of teaching satisfaction evaluation based on learners' perspective are obtained through LDA theme model: interactive communication, teaching arrangement, personal style, combination of content and practice, teaching skill level, courseware making and design, teaching style, acceptability of course content, classroom atmosphere and video presentation effect. Among them, the three most popular elements are classroom atmosphere, teaching style and video presentation effect. Finally, according to the research results, it not only provides a reference for the improvement of the teaching team and the management department, but also provides a new method and perspective for the evaluation of teaching satisfaction.

articleTitle: Chinese Undergraduates’ Behavior and Experiences of Internet Game Addiction: A Qualitative Case Study of CCNU via NVivo
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: In China, the number of game addicts has been upsurging among university students, but rare research has been dedicated to them from micro-perspective. To investigate the condition of college students' computer game addiction, this study conducted and recorded in-depth interviews among six undergraduates in CCNU, and then analyzed transcriptions of the recordings in NVivo. Researcher found that they take playing games as the main way of relaxing and effective socializing, and most of the them began to contact games at a very young age. Besides, online game addiction is related to both external conditions-equipment and teachers' management as well as internal feelings like their perceptions of pressure. To prevent or alleviate their game addiction, teachers and administers should pay attention to the students' emotional needs, strengthen the adaptability education for freshmen, and help students have clear career plans.

articleTitle: Research on the Connection Education between Kindergarten and Primary School Based on Education Informatization with PEST Model
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: This paper first studies the six major psychological faults of children in the early childhood connection stage in detail, which are related to people, learning style, behavioral norms, social structure, expectation level and learning environment, and interprets them from the perspective of educational psychology and psychology of child development. The author constructs the big data model of education informatization, calculates the relevant statistical data and gives the analysis results. Then, starting from the theoretical framework of supply and demand, the author analyzes the official authoritative data by building PEST model, and discusses the current development situation of China’s preschool education industry. In addition, this article uses the country comparison method, combined with the mature experience of several developed countries, such as the United States, France, Japan, to comprehensively and deeply explore the future development direction of China’s first grade prep class. To sum up, there is still a lot of room for the development of China’s cohesion for children in kindergarten and elementary school. This paper will go deeply into the current situation and future development trend of this field in China, with a view to providing suggestions and suggestions for relevant departments and education practitioners

articleTitle: Research on College English Language BL Teaching Mode Based on POA
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: Production-oriented approach (POA) adopts a three-step of teaching process of “motivating-enabling-evaluating”, and integrates teaching concepts of “Learning centered”, “Learning -using integrated” and “Whole-person education” throughout the teaching process. And with the rapid development of AI and network technology, the Blended Learning (BL) came into being as online self-learning has become an inevitable learning trend. BL is an “online + offline” learning that combines the advantages of online and traditional learning. This research explores the applicability of POA and BL in College Intensive Reading Course. Students' feedback and the teacher's reflection after one unit of teaching experiment show that: compared with traditional teaching methods of Intensive Reading lessons, this teaching mode combined with POA and BL is more effective, flexible and interesting, arousing students' enthusiasm for learning, cultivating students' abilities of language output, autonomous learning, group cooperation and critical thinking and etc. The new model of POA can effectively transform the input material from the received knowledge to the output knowledge by offering students the scenarios and task requirements and assessments to stimulate students' enthusiasm and creativity to complete the output task and assessment to a great extent. It improves the efficiency of English learning and promotes the comprehensive skills of college English majors. Meanwhile, BL can expand classroom resources and learning time and space, and the application of multi-modal media on the online learning platform also brings more fun and efficiency to learning and assessment. The combination of the two makes the teaching effect significant. Some difficulties and challenges are also discovered in implementation of POA and BL. Therefore, the joint efforts of the school and teachers are needed in the future teaching research and practice.

articleTitle: OLS Model Based Research on Entrepreneurial Education and Entrepreneurial Intention for Micro-ebusiness: an Evidence from China under the Impact of COVID-19
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: With application of STATA software, this study explores the relationship between entrepreneurial education and entrepreneurial intention of Chinese college students to do micro-ebusiness under the impact of the COVID-19. Based on OLS modeling, the survey data are processed through Person correlation and OLS regression analysis. The research results demonstrate that entrepreneurial education is positively correlated with the entrepreneurial intention, even after introducing other explanatory variables like institutional environment and family background, the relationship between entrepreneurial education and entrepreneurial intension is still significant and robust. Contrary to the results of previous studies, institutional environment and family background are found negatively correlated with entrepreneurial intension when entrepreneurial education and self-efficacy are introduced in the OLS model under the multivariate regression method. The study highlights the importance of entrepreneurial education to entrepreneurial intension, as well as provides policy implications to promote entrepreneurship under the impact of COVID-19 based on OLS modeling.

articleTitle: Practice and experience of online course construction—taking Food Chemistry as an example
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: At present, mobile phones, computers and other digital devices are very popular among college students. With the popularization of modem information technology, the traditional teaching methods must be reformed and innovated. The construction and implementation of online open courses meet this requirement. Based on the experience of “Food Chemistry ” online open course construction, this paper summarizes and suggests the role of online open course in the development of education and teaching, the content and standard of online open course construction, teachers' online teaching and supporting services, so as to provide a reference for online teaching and education.

articleTitle: Exploration of the Practice and Innovation Ability Training Mode of Internet of Things Engineering Students under the Background of New Engineering
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: Facing the requirements of new engineering for talent training objectives, the Internet of things engineering major of Northwest Normal University makes full use of off campus resources such as enterprises and society by means of curriculum system reform, heuristic teaching and effective use of network platform resources in the first classroom, innovation and entrepreneurship projects, team, platform construction and professional competition in the second classroom, and by cooperating with the third classroom. Actively exploring the new mode of reform and practice education has achieved remarkable results, which can provide reference for the construction of innovative engineering talents training mode in local colleges and universities.

articleTitle: Construction of the Evaluation System of Scientific Research Results Base on SPSS analysis– the Questionnaires of the 63 Universities in China
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: The evaluation system of scientific research results in universities is an important facet of the field of humanities and social science. It is also an important index of measuring the scientific research level of universities and teachers' scientific research competence. In the form of questionnaires, this paper thoroughly investigates the status quo of this evaluation system, including the evaluation of papers, works and application results, and also the advantages and shortages of new evaluation methods like the representative system, the third-party evaluation. The paper uses SPPS software to conduct descriptive analysis and inferential analysis on the questionnaire and find out the key factors of scientific research evaluation system. On the basis of the questionnaires, this paper also puts forward some suggestions on improving the evaluation system of scientific research results.

articleTitle: A Joint Course Knowledge Entity and Relation Extraction Method for Educational Data
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: Considering the current growth of data in Educational Field, especially in recent times, due to the COVID-19 epidemic, the volume of online course data has increased exponentially. How to extract useful entities and relations from mass educational data has turn into an academic hotspot. In traditional models, entity recognition and relation extraction are considered as two separate subtasks, which may cause error propagation. Therefore, the development of a more effective and accurate entity and relation extraction model in Educational Field is being widely studied. Here, we propose an entity and relation joint extraction method based on deep learning in Educational Field. The proposed model (XMMC) includes XLNet, a pretrained language model for obtaining text word vectors, Mogifier BiGRU neural network for obtaining text context information, Multi-headed Attention for focusing document key information, and CRF for extracting text entities. The obtained entity context information and entity label are further passed to the sigmoid function, which can enhance the accuracy of the subsequent relation extraction and achieve the goal of joint processing. The proposed model performs better than the existing model in terms of accuracy rates (P), recall rates (R), and F1 values (F1 scores).

articleTitle: Analysis of the Research Status and Development Trend of Integration Production and Education Based on CiteSpace
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: To evaluate the research progress and development trend of integration of production and education (IPE), this paper focuses on analyzing literature on the integration of production and education by visualization software CiteSpace. This article selects more than 6000 articles on the integration of production and education topics from 1996 to 2020 in the China National Knowledge Infrastructure (CNKI) database. From two dimensions of time and space, this paper uses trend charts and statistical table analysis to sort out the literature data, including the development trend of literature quantity, author distribution, organization distribution, citation rate, and so on. A series of knowledge graph studies, such as category analysis and co-occurrence analysis, are used to analyze the latest trends in the development trend, research hotspots, and the evolution of production and education integration. Finally, it pointed out that future research trends should focus on talent training, multi-agent collaborative education, and strengthening innovation and entrepreneurship education.

Author Keywords: the integration of production and education

articleTitle: A Visualization Study of Dance Teaching in China Based on the LDA Model and CSSCI Database (1998-2020)
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: Objective: Based on the topics of abstracts, times cited, and co-citation networks, this paper explores the knowledge system of dance teaching in China so as to provide a reference for future research based on bibliometrics. Method: According to the CSSCI database, a statistical analysis of Chinese research in dance teaching from 1998 to 2020 is carried out to discover implicit topics. In view of research hotspots and frontiers, this paper conducts a centrality and visualization analysis and a filtering of salient terms of research hotspots in dance teaching using CiteSpace, a knowledge graph visualization software. Also, the Latent Dirichlet Allocation model is used to extract and visualize the topics from the filtered salient terms of the abstracts. Results/Conclusion: We found that the research hotspots in dance teaching in China can be divided into 16 clusters, namely “Sports Dance”, “Dance Art”, “Classical Chinese Dance”, “Yunnan Dance”, “Dance”, “Folk Dance”, “Ethnic Dance”. “Dance teaching”, “Quality Education”, “College Students”, “Ethnic Minorities”. “Latin Dance”, “Traditional Athletic Maintenance”, “Chorus”, “Fitness Value”, and “Physical Fitness”. The research frontiers in dance teaching lie in the teaching, discovery, protection, restoration, and discipline construction of folk dance and intangible cultural heritage dance genres.

articleTitle: Research on Automatic Acquisition and Compilation of Office Software Secondary Development Based on Association Rules
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: Microsoft Office is an office automation software developed by Microsoft. Word, Excel, Power Point, Outlook and other application software we use are all components. Successful office software must have enough open characteristics to make it from an independent closed application software to an open office platform. Office software has been successfully applied in the software integration of many office automation systems. The realization of office automation is also the need of the development of colleges and universities. The use of office automation to deal with a large number of daily affairs can improve the efficiency of school management. Based on the association rules, this paper calls the functions of various types of development to realize some functions of secondary development of editing and editing automation. Input efficiency will be improved by completing wizard-style input for a variety of complex documents. Automation technology is used to solve the secondary development of Office documents, which better and fully reflects the convenience brought by software openness. The application and development prospects of Office secondary development are embarrassing. As more and more users have been learning about secondary development, a new era of “paperless office” will emerge, and enterprises and institutions will become the biggest beneficiaries.

articleTitle: Improving the Cultivation Ability of University International Students in China based on the Citespace
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: The impact of information technology on the education industry is revolutionary. Universities should improve the level of information technology, update concepts, and further improve the training capabilities of foreign students. Taking Dalian University of Technology as an example, this paper uses citespace software to visually analyze the training of Chinese students abroad, and analyzes the problems existing in the training of Chinese students abroad, and puts forward suggestions to further improve their training ability.

articleTitle: Antarctic Expedition Security Guarantee Marine Information Collection and Analysis Forecasting
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: From the perspective of global level on digital Earth and Earth big data, this paper elaborated the development process of previous Antarctic expeditions on digitization and big data of products (services) provided by the National Center for Marine Environment Forecasting of China in the past 36 years, including marine route monitoring and forecasting guarantee, "sea-land investigation" monitoring and forecasting guarantee, traffic monitoring and forecasting guarantee for harbor unloading and "land-air storage and transportation" of investigation ship (team); in which, this paper elaborated the source and role of forecasting big data on cruising observation, localized observation, station area observation, mobile observation, as well as big data reanalysis of satellite remote sensing information, besides, the practical effects of various products were elaborated; moreover, the briefly introduction of the construction progress and work status of scientific investigation stations in Antarctica, especially meteorological observation and forecast stations in China was given. Main achievements: Firstly, creatively completion of 36 batches of marine and atmospheric forecast and guarantee tasks for Antarctic expeditions in China; secondly, establishment of the environmental monitoring and forecasting guarantee system of "sea-air" for several maritime routes of Antarctic expeditions in China, that of "sea-land-air" for the surrounding Antarctic continent, and that of "land-air" for the Antarctic bay to the inland depth hinterland.

articleTitle: Research on the SERVQUAL Quality Model of E-commerce Entrepreneurship Education Quality Management
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: Based on the SERVQUAL model, the paper, aiming at the five-dimensional evaluation model of e-commerce entrepreneurship curriculum education service quality management in colleges and universities, selects 10 university ecommerce entrepreneurship courses as cases. When the instructor is a dual-teacher type and only uses the flipped classroom teaching method, we evaluate the quality of education services from the perspective of student perception, hoping to explore the gaps in the evaluation of e-commerce entrepreneurship curriculum education services from various dimensions. The research finds: (1) Under the condition of adopting traditional e-commerce entrepreneurship courses, the quality of education services generally gives students a low sense of identity, and there is not much room for improvement, showing that traditional ecommerce teachers have little effect on the quality of entrepreneurship education; (2) among all dimensions, the highest satisfaction is teacher's practice major and the diversification of flipped classroom teaching with internet multimedia courseware, showing that simultaneous existence of flipped classroom practice teaching will help maximize quality satisfaction.

articleTitle: Preface: icise-ie 2020
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: 2020 International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE2020) is hosted by Chongqing University, hosted by AEIC Academic Exchange Center, and co-organized by Chongqing Jiaotong University, Chongqing University of Technology, Chongqing Technology and Business University, and Chongqing Normal University. 2020 International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE2020) was successfully held on December 4-6, 2020 in Sanya, China. ICISE-IE 2020 is to bring together innovative academics and industrial experts in the field of Information Science and Education to a common forum. The primary goal of the conference is to promote research and developmental activities in Information Science and Education and another goal is to promote scientific information interchange between researchers, developers, engineers, students, and practitioners working all around the world. The conference will be held every year to make it an ideal platform for people to share views and experiences in Information Science and Education and related areas. The conference model was divided into two sessions, including oral presentations and keynote speeches. In the first part, some scholars, whose submissions were selected as the excellent papers, were given 15 minutes to perform their oral presentations one by one. Then in the second part, keynote speakers were each allocated 30-45 minutes to hold their speeches. There were over 120 experts and scholars in the area of Information Science and Education representing different famous universities and institutes around the globe to attend our conference.
